fields.value: Bioprototype, a Roguelike & Skill Customizing Rhapsody! This is an auto-bomber with programming elements. Customize your character skills with visual programming, utilize enemy organs to finish the mutation, and construct the ultimate prototype, one can survive in the endless wave of flesh.

Ninja Stars is an action-packed arcade game where players strategically fire and deflect ninja stars to break down surrounding walls. Use physics-based ricochet mechanics and precision aiming to eliminate obstacles and clear the level. With each wall sequence presenting new challenges, it’s a test of both reflexes and strategy as you work to complete each stage!

Fly a spaceship through deep space and survive as long as you can!
Asteroids appear in your path — shoot them to earn points.
Large asteroids break into smaller pieces when hit.
Destroy the smallest ones to score even more!

But be careful: if any asteroid piece crashes into your ship, it’s game over.
Stay alert, keep moving, and test your reflexes in this fast-paced space shooter!

Breaker Brick Smashing is an endless brick breaker challenge where new bricks constantly appear and only the sharpest shots survive. Smash your way through tougher bricks that need multiple hits, collect power-ups like extra balls and safe zones, and climb through the waves as difficulty rises. How long can you last?

Control a shadowy, winged angel in Dark Angels as you ram through rocks, crystals, and cursed barriers, absorbing dark energy along the way. With a blend of dark fantasy and arcade action, each level challenges you to clear obstacles and harness the power of darkness.

Bacrush is a fast-paced arcade game where you control a small green square. Your goal is to collect as many coins as possible while dodging dangerous gray cubes. You can shoot projectiles to push back the cubes, but be careful — shooting too much will cause your square to overheat! Gather as many coins as you can and survive as long as possible to set a new high score.

In this charming and challenging game, you play as a shepherd with a critical mission — guide your flock safely into the barn without letting any sheep fall off cliffs or drown in the water. Use fear wisely to steer the sheep, but be careful — push them too hard, and they might panic and run to their doom! The more sheep you safely herd into the barn, the higher your score. Master the delicate balance between control and chaos in this fun and strategic herding adventure!

Weed Shop Simulator launches in Early Access! Build your cannabis empire from seed to sale. Grow rare strains, craft legendary products, hire your team, and outsmart rivals in a chaotic world full of wild adventures and deep cannabis culture. Your empire awaits!

Lucky Drop is a fun game of chance where you release balls and watch where they land. The path through obstacles is always different, and each launch brings excitement and the challenge to score as many points as possible. A perfect game to relax and test your luck – simple, fast, and addictive!

Maze: Interim Odyssey is a sequel spin-off to the hit puzzle adventure game, Maze: Pedestal of Trials. This entry into the TreeFall Studios Maze series brings all new challenges, complex puzzles, and new environments.

Taking place between "Pedestal of Trials" and the upcoming "Rising Trials" this Maze side story can be picked up and played by fans of the series or complete newcomers.
A memory game dedicated to the letters that guide us through the day.

Welcome to Boxstacker, a game where you pilot your brave ship around obstacles, stack boxes below yourself and close portals with them! Maneuver around meteors, defeat patrolling enemies, stack boxes and close portals below. Try to beat your high score!

Ice Block Slide Rush is a fast paced endless challenge where timing and precision are everything. Press to charge and release to slide. The harder you squash the ice block, the farther it slides. Smash into other blocks and try to land perfectly in the glowing zone. Miss the mark and your block gets chopped down. The smaller the block, the harder it is to push the next one. With only 3 lives, how far can you go on this slippery ride?

From the makers of the Jumping Food Games comes the next whirling adventure on the plate. In "The Jumping Spaghetti" you control an elastic noodle through 28 varied levels full of obstacles, rotating platforms and surprising twists and turns.
3D Snakes and Ladders is a visually enhanced digital version of the classic board game, set in a dynamic 3D environment. Players move across a 3D board filled with animated snakes and ladders.

% is a puzzle game where you have to figure out how to get 12 gauges labeled with Greek letters filled to +100% and -100% respectively.
This is done by changing the cells on the playing field in accordance to the distribution table which is generated in the start of the game.

Buddy Garden is a cozy pixel-art sokoban puzzle game where you play as Buddy, a cheerful husky with a mission: tidy up the garden by pushing seed sacks into the right spots. Solve relaxing puzzles across charming farm environments that bloom as you progress, one sack, one season at a time.
Get ready for an adrenaline-pumping 3D bike racing adventure! Zoom through stunning environments with ultra-realistic graphics and smooth controls.

Dive into the bustling world of Weed & Greed, where you'll build your illicit empire from the ground up!

Find clients or hire dealers to keep your business thriving and establish a loyal customer base. But be ready for intense action: battle NPCs and cops, arm yourself, and rule the streets like a true boss.

Explore a dynamic city with day-night cycles and shady corners perfect for deals. Build your empire by cultivating plants, synthesizing pills, and upgrading your equipment.

Rent labs, warehouses, and stash houses to dominate the game!

Forget SUPERCARS, this is how real legends race! Dash through endless dunes, Outrun your rivals, and gobble up power-ups to stay in the lead. It's wild, it's fast — do you have what it takes to become the ultimate Egyptian champion?

Slay skeletons and goblins in nonstop action!
In this fast-paced 2D action game, you control a fearless knight battling endless enemies across shifting platforms. Time your strikes, stay on the move, and see how long you can survive the onslaught!
Dive into retro twin-stick chaos in Astro Surge! Shoot through endless waves, level up fast, and unleash pixel-powered mayhem in space.

In this retro-style platformer, play as Catherine, a witch and tomb raider caught in a cursed dimension after stealing a forbidden artifact.

Blast enemies with magic fireballs, solve puzzles, and escape the clutches of the Cat Demon across 15 pixel-perfect levels inspired by ‘90s classics.

Content King: Streamer Simulator puts you behind the camera with one goal—build a streaming career from scratch and turn it into something worth watching.

Start with basic gear and zero followers. Stream regularly, improve your content, and grow your audience. Upgrade your setup, manage your time, and decide how you’ll rise—stay genuine, stir the pot, or cut corners for quicker success.

Expand your channel, work with other creators, and turn your online presence into a serious business. Just don’t forget: the internet loves a star—but it loves a scandal even more. Ready to chase clout or chaos? The camera’s on.

Sokmeal Time is a cozy sokoban game where you guide a hungry corgi through handcrafted puzzles. Move empty bowls into place, solve satisfying logic challenges, and watch kibble appear as your reward. With a relaxing flow, playful charm, this is a game that makes every solved puzzle feel like a warm treat.
Cyber Tank Nano is a puzzle game which adds various mechanics on top of the Sokoban genre

Welcome to BITS BATS BALLS - the place where your dual-analog reflexes are put to the test! Destroy blocks, collect bits, and progress from one level to the next, only to find yourself in an infinite mode catered for the most hardcore of players!

Gemz Burst puts you in control of a high-speed ship orbiting a deadly space zone. Fire toward the center to break spinning rings of energy gems and expose the turret core at the heart of the chaos. Time your shots and dodge incoming fire as you blast through each layer of danger in this intense outer-ring shooter.

In Echoes of Light, step into the worn boots of Kaela, a lone swordswoman on a desperate journey to rescue her kidnapped brother and restore the balance between light and shadow.

Explore a crumbling world consumed by darkness as you fight your way through corrupted forests, forgotten temples, and realms beyond time. With no magic to aid you-only steel and skill-you'll face brutal enemies and haunting bosses, each guarding a piece of the truth.
SFERA - Action platformer. A mix of 3D and retro 2D graphics. You are an assassin for the SFERA corporation. You are tasked with destroying a gang of robots.
An asymmetric horror game where four survivors try to escape an Italian monster-maniac by solving puzzles and completing tasks. Repair the Bombardiro Crocodilo and run!

The main challenge lies in guiding the stream of water around obstacles that block its direct path to the cup. With only a limited supply of water, players must think strategically by avoiding unnecessary barriers and carefully managing their resources to fill the cup and bring a smile to its face. As the game progresses, each level becomes difficult.

In their desperation, the invading force has activated an antimatter bomb.

Now, the void is consuming everything in its path.

All Neon strike teams have been ordered to evacuate the solar system. Hold off the remaining enemy forces to buy them enough time.

Glowface is back - and this time his heart is beating even brighter. A new chapter full of magic, adventure and emotion begins in "Glowface in Love 2". Accompany the glowing hero on a journey through 28 new levels in which not only tricky puzzles but also emotional twists and turns await him.

In Sparkrina, play as a fierce sorceress sprinting through endless realms packed with deadly traps and demonic foes. Unleash magic, dodge danger, and see how long you can survive in this fast-paced fantasy runner!

In those gritty concrete jungle streets, it takes a real man to prove himself. Take on the persona of THE ULTIMATE G and prove yourself on those streets! Defeat enemies, level up, and build a powerful warrior out of yourself from the wide array of perks! But be wary - your enemies improve just as much as you do...

MORTAR is a fast-paced one-button game.

You are in charge of a mortar that constantly moves from side to side on its own. Your goal is to destroy the enemy tanks that are approaching you from the top. Hold a button to fire a bomb ahead and destroy all the enemies within the radius of its explosion. Or press a button to shoot the enemies with a small shot. You stop moving when you shoot or fire a bomb.

The game is over when any enemy reaches the bottom of the screen.

The ongoing clash between two anomalies has taken its toll.
As they rose closer to the surface, the water around them has become increasingly toxic.
If the toxicity continues to spread, the consequences could be severe.
Could this disaster end if one anomaly prevails?

Classic Arcades: Pong brings the legendary black-and-white paddle game back with crisp visuals and tight controls. Play solo against the CPU with three difficulty levels or challenge a friend in local 2-player mode. It’s first to 11 in this pure, minimalist throwback—no frills, just fast-paced arcade action.

In Majestreats, you play as a hungry holiday princess on a royal quest for delicious treats! Dash through sunny beaches and resort paths, collecting burgers, ice cream, and chocolate — but watch out for the pesky mosquitoes! Each bite will cost you precious points, so stay sharp and keep those snacks coming.

A lighthearted, fast-paced adventure full of yummy fun and royal flair!

Close For The Night is a first-person horror game about a blogger who explores mysterious locations sent by his subscribers. Each place tells its own standalone story filled with dark secrets, paranormal activity, and unexpected events waiting in the shadows.

Beam Driver — become a master driver and explore new horizons!
Get ready for an exhilarating adventure in the world of Beam Driver, where the lines between reality and virtuality blur! In this game, you will become a true driver capable of performing incredible tricks and maneuvers that will astonish even the most seasoned motorsport enthusiasts.
Fast Gear is a high-intensity 3D car racing game built for PC, offering both thrilling single-player challenges and competitive online multiplayer PvP action.

Meteor Break Mission is a 2D arcade shooter where you control a cannon to destroy falling meteors, earn points and money, and upgrade your health, fire rate, and shot power. Survive as long as you can and aim for the highest score!

Sushi Attack is a playful arcade shooter where you control a single animated chopstick to defend your wasabi from waves of mischievous sushi invaders. With vibrant visuals and escalating challenges, it’s a fun twist on a classic arcade experience.
Solve the mystery behind bizarre nightmares in this immersive Full Motion Video Game.

It's easy - just take a cash delivery. Find a problem you need to solve. Clean the money. Send it back to your customers. Repeat.

Don't be afraid to get your hands dirty - it's part of your business. You are a cash cleaner. So do your job. And do it well, or face the consequences.

To achieve results, you need tools and equipment, so buy everything you need and turn your lab into a dream place.

Engage in card-based combat against alluring opponents in a fantasy world! Face beautiful but dangerous combatants, all with unique stats, strengths and weaknesses. In each turn, you are randomly dealt cards of four action types.

In Spikoin, every coin is a step toward victory — but one wrong move could cost you! Jump your way through tight corridors, deadly spikes, and tricky platforms in this fast-paced coin-collecting platformer.

Your goal? Collect all coins in the level to unlock the next one. Sounds easy? Think again.

Step into the chaos of Sector Shooter, a fast-paced action game where you’ll battle through a series of themed sectors, from dusty desert to deep industrial mines. Face a variety of enemies, collect coins and buffs, and push forward through increasingly challenging sectors. Each sector contains a set number of enemies that must be defeated before you can move on. As you progress, upgrade your character and weapons, sharpen your reflexes, and prepare for a challenging boss fight showdown.

Rabbit Run Carrot Hunt is a fast-paced endless runner where you play as a quick and clever rabbit trying to collect as many carrots as possible. Carrots restore your energy, which slowly depletes as you run. The longer you survive, the more points you earn. A black panther is chasing you and occasionally launches sudden attacks that you must jump over to avoid. At the same time, you need to dodge various obstacles along the way. Stay alert, keep collecting carrots, and run as far as you can before the panther catches you.

Calc+- is a fun and brain-teasing puzzle game where you work with numbers. Each level gives you a set of number blocks. Using your controller, you can add, subtract, multiply, or divide them. Your goal? Make the final number match the target number. The more levels you beat, the harder it gets. How far can your brain take you?

Beanball is a fast-paced arcade game where you pilot a small spaceship and dodge incoming asteroids. The longer you survive, the more points you earn. Collect coins to boost your score and stay ahead!

But the real twist? If your ship gets destroyed, you can rewind time to bring it back—just be careful, your rewind energy is limited. Run out, and it’s game over!

How long can you last in the asteroid storm?

Fly Light is a game in which you need to turn on lamps located on 4 different sides, thereby attracting midges to you. Thus, you need to lure as many midges as possible to the exploding area. But you need to be careful, because if you attract a midge too close to you, it can sit on the lamp, thereby partially blocking the glow range of the lamp, which will mean that you will not be able to attract a new midge so easily. You will lose when the midges stick to one of the lamps so that it can no longer shine. You get points for the number of midges destroyed using explosions.
The third edition of the popular Arab Drift Cars game, specifically in Riyadh. Start playing, drifting, and drifting now with the most famous cars and maps.

FORMULA is a game in which you need to fly a ball and collect elements of the formula. After each collection, the shape of the curve of the field changes, along which you can move. Points are awarded after selecting each element of the formula. The game ends when the ball touches the walls of the narrowing field.

Grab your bandana and load up — it’s time for Brotillery!
Dash through chaotic warzones as a one-bro army, blasting enemies, dodging traps, and collecting coins. It’s a wild, fast-paced run ’n gun with retro vibes and nonstop explosions.

Simple controls, endless action, and full bro-power!

Welcome to Pic-A-Block, a brand new puzzle game from TreeFall Studios. Pic-A-Block is a 3D spatial brain teaser game. The goal of the game is to recreate 2D images in 3D by positioning blocks in a manner that matches the picture you are given.

Icenoid is a fun and easy-to-play brick-breaking game. Use the paddle to bounce the ball and destroy all the blocks on the screen. Break them all to complete each level!

Collect a wide variety of power-ups that make the game easier — ball, paddle upgrades, and even rockets that blast through bricks. But be careful! Not all drops are helpful — some power-downs will make things harder, so you’ll need to dodge them quickly.

"Cazzarion: Raccoon Valley" is a relaxing nature adventure where you play as a curious raccoon exploring a lush valley filled with rivers, a serene lake, dense trees, and open meadows. Roam freely through the landscape in search of tasty critters like snails, worms, frogs, and more. With no enemies, it's all about foraging, exploring, and enjoying the peaceful rhythm of the wild.

Step into the pixelated woods in this retro-inspired arcade adventure where you play as the Witch of the Forest. Collect magical ingredients, battle enemies with fiery spells, and brew the potion throughout endless levels. Simple, nostalgic, and endlessly replayable - perfect for fans of classic 80’s arcade fun!

Earth Defense Sticks is a fun and fast-paced 2D arcade game where you play as the planet Earth!

Asteroids are coming from all directions, and your job is to survive as long as possible. To help you, you have four powerful defense sticks — one on each side of the planet: top, bottom, left, and right. Press the matching buttons to extend the sticks and smash incoming asteroids.

Each asteroid you destroy gives you points. The more you hit, the higher your score!
Simple to play, hard to master — how long can you protect the Earth?

The Chase is an endless driving game where you take the role of a driver on the run from the police. Set on an open, continuous maps, the objective is simple: stay ahead of the cops for as long as possible while avoiding obstacles and collecting essential items like fuel, magnets, coins and presents. With high-speed chases, explosive crashes, and unlockable vehicles and environments, The Chase delivers a heart-pounding experience.
The game is the abandoned monument of Buzludzha and the game included a winter season of atmosphere as real. You have to look for some buttons and an exit.

A beautifully framed interactive book with 4 whimsical, surreal short novels.
Follow 4 different protagonists on their dreamlike journeys.

Your choice matters! See what ending you get!

The Flying Jet is an exhilarating endless runner game set in tunnels where players must navigate obstacles, collect points, and seize special items that grant temporary invincibility, double scores, or time slowdowns. As player accumulate points, the pace quickens, intensifying the challenge. Dodge obstacles, gather points, and push your reflexes to the limit in this adrenaline-fueled adventure!

It's easy - just take the cash delivery. Find the problem you need to solve. Clean the money. Send it back to your clients. Repeat.

Don't be afraid to get your hands dirty - it's a part of your business. You are a cash cleaner. So do your job. And do it well or you will face the consequences.

You need tools and equipment to get the result, so buy what you need and make your lab a dream place.

Play and explore the city of Riyadh in the Kingdom of
Saudi Arabia.

Step into the driver’s seat of a powerful forklift and experience the true-to-life challenges of cargo handling. From carefully lifting pallets to stacking heavy loads at different heights, this simulator will test your precision, patience, and skill. Each mission brings new obstacles, requiring focus, balance, and accuracy to succeed.

Players guide a playful young monkey through lush, vibrant jungles filled with colorful animal companions. At its core, Monkey Lost tells a story of friendship, perseverance, and the search for home. With its charming characters, delightful visuals, and family-friendly design, the game offers a jungle journey that appeals to players of all ages.

The waters surrounding the anomalies are now almost completely devoid of life as the mysterious conflict between the unknown entities still rages on.

Should one anomaly prevail, the harmful substance left in the wake of battle would no longer be present. If that were to be the case, life could flourish once again in this deserted part of the ocean.

Which anomaly will emerge victorious?

What if a mysterious notebook could write your life’s story before it even happens?
In Blue Notebook, a gripping story-driven visual novel, you step into the shoes of Leo, a 17-year-old boy struggling with loneliness, new beginnings, and a strange diary that seems to know his every move—even predicting his final day.

After moving to a quiet town with hopes of starting fresh, Leo discovers an unsettling blue notebook hidden beneath his bed. Its pages are filled with personal memories, private feelings, and even future events no one could possibly know—not even his only friend, Rita. As Leo searches for answers, reality blurs, friendships are tested, and an ominous countdown begins.

Your choices will shape Leo’s fragile journey. Will you uncover the truth behind the notebook? Can you change the course of fate, or will you simply follow the story already written for you?

Welcome to Blaster Orbit, a high-speed pixel-art arcade shooter where survival and score go hand-in-hand.

Pilot your ship through an endless cosmic battlefield filled with hostile alien fleets, deadly projectiles, and shimmering coins waiting to be grabbed. Dodge, blast, and weave your way through beautifully animated retro space environments while racking up high scores.

Switch between precise shooting and evasive flying as you power up your ship, collect health, and chase orbiting coins for massive score boosts. With smooth controls, vibrant visuals, and non-stop action, Blaster Orbit brings back the thrill of classic shoot-'em-ups—with a modern endless twist.

How long can you survive the orbit?

Test your limits in Only Up 2025 — a dynamic adventure where every step, jump, and movement takes you higher and higher. This game combines spectacular vertical arcade action with realistic movement simulation, delivering a unique climbing experience.

This vibrant and fun-filled slot machine game brings the excitement of the casino right to your screen, letting you choose your number of lines, set your bet amount, and spin your way to sweet wins. With its simple gameplay, catchy visuals, and satisfying rewards, it’s the perfect game for casual players and slot fans alike—no complicated rules, just pure spinning joy!

Reflex Drop Time Race is a fast-paced arcade challenge where you control a square leaping from block to block, racing against time and testing your reflexes. Tap left or right to land on the correct side, collect time bonuses, and survive as long as possible. One wrong move — and it’s game over.

Welcome to the past of the future. "Galactic Guardian 1988" takes you into a retro-inspired endless game in classic black and white arcade style. As a brave pilot, you face endless waves of asteroids - in a tribute to the golden era of arcades.

In this unique escape-room game, you awaken as a newly launched AI trapped within the depths of a computer. Your mission is to escape, but the path isn't simple. Inspired by 90s-era computer interfaces, the game challenges you to solve complex puzzles and decipher codes to find your way to freedom.

In every part of the world, they emerge to bring much needed joy and new life to this miraculous existence of ours.

This memory game is dedicated to the flowers that surround us.

Blablublas Battle Royale Shooter drops you into a vibrant world where you face off against numerous challengers in a high-stakes competition. As the last contender standing, you must rely on your instincts and quick thinking to outlast every opponent. The journey challenges your decision-making and perseverance as you fight to become the ultimate champion and secure your place among the legends of Blablublas land. Each encounter pushes you to adapt and stay sharp in the relentless battle for survival. Prepare to test your limits as you overcome fierce competition and prove your dominance in this thrilling solo experience. The path to victory is tough, but only one can claim the crown.

Beam Moto Driver Playground is a realistic motorcycle simulator where you'll face thrilling jumps, challenging tracks, and true-to-life crash physics. Test your skills on an extreme desert track designed for those who crave speed, freedom, and adrenaline-pumping stunts.
Beam Moto Driver Playground is your playground for speed, stunts, and survival on two wheels. Are you ready to conquer the desert?
Catch the best leaves for your tea! But wait, they have to ferment first. So you still have a chance to sort the leaves after catching.

BodyCam 2025 throws you into the heart of intense conflict, where speed and precision matter more than ever. Explore realistic environments and react quickly to every critical situation, using your arsenal to overcome dangerous challenges. Each mission tests your reflexes and strategy, and fast decisions can make the difference between success and failure. Face every obstacle head-on. Adapt or be defeated.

Step into the role of a master gunsmith in Gunsmith Master Simulator. Design,
craft, and refine an impressive variety of firearms, tailoring each weapon to meet
precise standards. Explore the mechanics of guns in depth, perfecting
performance, balance, and handling while managing your workshop and tools.

Hymer 2000 is an interactive text puzzle game, where players freely converse with the "Hymer" and use an open "Search" function to retrieve past conversations. By discovering keywords, gathering clues, and collecting "Faces", players uncover Hymer's secrets and ultimately shut it down.

Something is wrong. Your thoughts are hazy, your memory shattered — but one thing is clear: you’re being hunted. The presence drawn to your fear.

You don’t know how it started. You don’t know what it wants. But it won’t stop.

It watches. It waits. And then… it strikes.

There’s no time to think — only time to run. Find a way to survive the impossible.
Every second counts. Every sound could be your last.

Chase the burgers to unlock new friends. Experience the world of Puppolonia as a canine running through the capital city of Puppolonia collecting burgers. The player will collect letters to learn to spell various words related to canines. The player will jump and dodge obstacles in the course on the city streets while collecting power ups, letters, and burgers.

A minimalist game where you venture into a snowy world filled with mysteries and glacial secrets. Explore by melting snow with a heat cannon, collect valuable resources and ancient artifacts, and rescue frozen characters. But most importantly — find and assemble the remains of an ancient Mammoth!

First-person adventure game, playable solo or co-op with up to 4 people. Travel through unique areas, uncover memories and use them to craft powerful potions. Unlock special abilities and solve puzzles in a mysterious world. Will your soul survive this journey?
Welcome to Beastro! In this charming fusion of fantasy adventure, not all heroes wield swords… Some prefer the spoon. And, sometimes to save the world you’ve got to start with a really good meal.

A frantic fast-paced beat 'em up roguelike full of crass, brass and incredibly badass. Become THE Mexican Ninja as you slice your way through the streets of Nuevo Tokyo in this retro 2.5D arcade throwback. So what’chu waiting for? Show me your skills pinche ninja!

Embark on a captivating adventure with Max, a plush rabbit brought to life!

Unfold the secrets hidden within captivating portals, venturing from the bustling streets of New York City to the enigmatic depths of an alien bunker. Face hordes of enemies in exhilarating battles, unravel mind-bending puzzles, and navigate challenging platforming sections.

Welcome to the Snowboard Syndicate! Race, Compete, and Explore the slopes as a colorful cast of unique characters! But what’s snowboarding without a little bit of drip? Through exploring and racing, you can unlock cosmetics such as designs for your snowboard and clothes to make sure you shine the brightest while shredding.

Prize Fighter is a FMV boxing game which puts the player in the body of a boxer known as "The Kid" and must face off against four opponents: Honeyboy Fernandez, Mega Joe Falco, Rex Hawkins, and, the ultimate challenge, Nuke "The Duke" Johnson, over the course of two CDs.

Fundación 3M España - The Recycling Heroes is an educational game for up to 4 players that conveys the importance of recycling to protect the environment.

It is designed for all types of people, regardless of their abilities. To achieve this, it uses PlayLink technology, which allows for controls adapted to each user simply by using a mobile device.

To further enhance accessibility, the game also offers the option to activate subtitles, sign language, and easy-to-read text.

In this game you must drop pigs into a box to hold it on the balance.
The pigs affect the balance according to their distance from the Chinese motorcycle.

Match 3 pigs of the same color vertically or horizontally to remove them from the playfield.

Every pig has its own weight, so let them fall wisely. The weight is shown in the nose of each pig.

If one side of the box hits the ground, the game is over.

Use special pigs like column cleaner pig, row cleaner pig and the joker pig for a faster playfield cleaning and better score.
Dodge the bullets and the lines to increase the score.

Race a hover car around 2 tracks with 3 modes: normal race where you have to come first in 2 laps, royale where you win when you reach first place against a large number of cars and bomb where you race around 1 lap dodging balls which are dropped by a large hovercar which stays in the lead at all times.
4 people can play all the above modes against each other in local split screen multiplayer.

It is finally springtime! The first flowers and grasses awakened from hibernation and a cute little
pig too.
Push a button to Jump!
Pig versus Box is a simple but addictive game. By pushing a button on your controller, the tiny pig
jumps. You always must land on a crate without being hit by its movement. If you're good, the
crates will stack up high into the sky.
Try to get as high as you can to beat your own high score and don´t be so angry if you lose ;)
Fight bandits and try to sleep.

Help the fluffy bird escape the dark fountain by pressing a button to dodge obstacles. Move quickly as the water rises and Flupp the fish tries to block your way. See how high you can go and beat your high score in this fun, fast-paced game.

Rocket Spin Orbit Glide is a fast-paced arcade game where you control a spinning rocket, thrust forward with precise timing, dodge deadly obstacles, and collect power boosts to soar through space. The farther you go, the higher your score!
Meow and the Diamond Jump is a casual platformer featuring 40 levels, progressive difficulty, and infinite lives.

Void Source Origins is a top-down shooter game set in space

You control a spacecraft that can shoot 4 different weapons (collectable as bonuses), travel at very high speeds and orbit planets.

The ultimate survival challenge begins now! In The Last Zone, the battle for humanity’s last stronghold reaches its climax. No longer a test – this is the real war. Armed with powerful weapons, tactical tools, and your will to survive, you must stand your ground against relentless waves of mutated enemies. Every decision, every shot, every second matters.

Enter the Forest of Terenu, a mysterious, otherworldly realm steeped in sorrow, memory, and the remnants of lost souls. In this gripping visual novel, you become Ellis, a 17-year-old girl searching for her missing brother, guided only by a flickering flame and the distant echoes of the past.

After falling asleep one night and awakening in a dreamlike yet menacing forest, Ellis finds herself trapped in a realm where light has faded and grief has taken root. The only constant is a strange glowing orb—her only source of light, and perhaps, her only ally.

As Ellis ventures deeper into the shadows of Terenu, she meets peculiar spirits and lost wanderers, each bearing pieces of a much larger puzzle: a tragedy buried in time and a curse that binds them all. Some want to help, others deceive. But all are haunted.
And Ellis is no exception.

Will you uncover the truth hidden beneath the trees—or be consumed by the darkness yourself?

Welcome to Blaster Orbit, a high-speed pixel-art arcade shooter where survival and score go hand-in-hand.

Pilot your ship through an endless cosmic battlefield filled with hostile alien fleets, deadly projectiles, and shimmering coins waiting to be grabbed. Dodge, blast, and weave your way through beautifully animated retro space environments while racking up high scores.

Switch between precise shooting and evasive flying as you power up your ship, collect health, and chase orbiting coins for massive score boosts. With smooth controls, vibrant visuals, and non-stop action, Blaster Orbit brings back the thrill of classic shoot-'em-ups—with a modern endless twist.

In Drug Dealer: Schedule I, you’re not just pushing product—you’re building an empire. Start small, flipping low-grade supply in back alleys, then climb your way up to managing labs, controlling distribution, and running the streets like a pro.

Expand your network, recruit a crew you can trust (or at least afford), and outsmart rivals and law enforcement. Every decision counts: one smart move can make you a fortune, one mistake can take it all away.

Refine your supply chain, dominate your territory, and keep your reputation sharp. This isn’t about chaos—it’s about strategy, growth, and staying one step ahead.

Hustle smart. Grow fast. Own everything.

"Carpieces is a fun and quirky arcade game where you control a tiny car that grows over time. The bigger you get, the more points you earn!

Crash into smaller trees to split your car in two and keep going — each new piece keeps scoring! But be careful: hit a tree that's bigger than you, and it's game over.

How far can you go before the forest stops you?"

Orb Slide Dodge Danger is a fast-paced 2D arcade game where you control a rolling orb moving from right to left. Hold to dash forward, dodge incoming obstacles, and collect glowing bonuses to increase your score. The more points you earn, the harder the challenge gets — with faster hazards and shifting background colors that reflect your progress. How long can you survive the danger?

Step into the budding world of entrepreneurship with Cannabis Shop Simulator, the ultimate business management game where your dreams of running a thriving cannabis shop become reality. From a humble start to dominating the green market, every decision you make will shape the future of your empire.

Trapped in an endless maze of yellow-tinted halls and eerie silence, your only hope is to find the exit before you lose your mind. The Backrooms: Maze Escape is a first-person exploration game inspired by the viral Backrooms mythos, where every hallway looks the same and reality feels distant. Collect as many coins as possible and try to complete each level as quickly as you can. Navigate two increasingly unsettling levels with no map and no guidance - only your memory and instincts.

Fast, sweet and full of energy: In "The Jumping Strawberry" you can expect a challenging endless game in which you jump and dodge through a world full of obstacles with an agile strawberry.

Jump your way through a fast-paced adventure that puts your reaction and precision to the test. Every platform counts - one wrong jump and the game starts all over again.

With lovingly drawn cartoon graphics and smooth controls, "The Jumping Strawberry" delivers fast-paced fun with real addictive potential.

WARNING: JUMPING ROBOT!
The complex is collapsing, and you’ve got just one chance and… one button!

Control a broken robot that can only jump and try to escape the underground halls.
Each room hides a trap: hit the switches to open the door, but beware — the floor crumbles right after you leap!

One-button control: just press and jump!

Relaxing soundtrack to soothe the chaos of escape.

Easy to pick up, hard to master: a simple idea that quickly becomes a test of reflexes and precision.
Step into a retro-inspired maze as a quick-footed plumber on a mission to repair leaking pipes. Earn points, climb levels, and survive the rising steam in this throwback arcade challenge!

Embrace two forms in this unique puzzle-platformer! As a solid cat, leap and run through treacherous platforming challenges. Then, dive into a pipe and transform into a liquid cat! Rotate the pipes to solve intricate puzzles and create a safe path to the exit. With 40 progressively difficult levels, Liquid Cat offers a refreshing blend of fast-paced action and brain-bending logic.

Slide into the fiery chaos in Polar Outta Place, an endless runner where you're a very lost polar bear dashing through molten mayhem. Dodge slimes, leap over fire pits, and snatch up shiny coins—all while trying not to become a toasted marshmallow.

With simple controls, fast-paced action, and a ridiculous setting, this is one run you won’t forget. Stay cool, move fast, and prove that even the most out-of-place bear can beat the heat!

Get ready for an addictive challenge where precision, timing, and quick reflexes are the keys to survival!

Guide your ball through a narrow brick tunnel filled with dangerous red spikes and tricky obstacles. Jump at the right moment, avoid deadly traps, and collect shining stars along the way to boost your score. Every second counts as you push your limits to stay alive longer and rack up points.
For a Few Minutes is an emotional visual novel that explores love, grief, and the fragile hope of moving forward.

Jump Land Glow Challenge is a fast-paced arcade game where precise timing is everything. Jump high, dive fast, and land perfectly on glowing platforms to change the background and earn points. Each successful landing increases the challenge, speed, and intensity in a vibrant, ever-shifting world of color. How long can you keep up the rhythm?

Start simulating drifting and racing in the State of Qatar. You can choose a male or female character, and start playing, drifting, racing and Hajwala and Drift simulating with the most beautiful realistic cars and cities of the State of Qatar. You can also modify your car, live in your house and roam around the cities

Embark on an epic adventure in Tiny Archer, a breathtaking 2D platformer set in a dangerous, slime-infested dungeon! As a nimble archer, fight through 20 treacherous levels filled with cunning slimes, each requiring clever tactics to defeat. Master wall-jumping to navigate deadly traps, collect crystals, and grab powerful quivers that unleash triple-shot barrages of devastating power. With precise controls and diverse enemies, Tiny Archer offers thrilling combat and exploration.

From the makers of the popular Jumping Food Games, the sugary fun returns. In "The Jumping Bonbon Match 4" you can expect new challenges, even more colorful candies and enhanced puzzle gameplay.

Look forward to over 15 new levels, more sophisticated match mechanics and surprising obstacles that will put your skill and planning to the test. With fresh cartoon graphics and improved animations, every level is an experience.

The sweet adventure continues - ready for the next round of candy chaos?

Oh, Canada! is a fast-paced trivia game that challenges your knowledge of the Great White North in a high-stakes, game show-style format. Answer 15 increasingly difficult questions drawn from a curated pool of over 40, covering Canadian geography, history, pop culture, and more, as you climb from $100 to a pretend $1,000,000. Use lifelines like Call a Friend, Ask the Public, and 50/50 to stay in the game, with full gamepad support and a dramatic soundtrack to keep the pressure on. Whether you're a proud Canuck or just maple-curious, Oh, Canada! brings quiz-night fun to your living room.

Flipbomb is a fast paced one-button game where you press any button and activate a flipper. But there's a twist, instead of a ball, you are hitting bombs! Quite handy, in fact, because there's a rain of debris coming down your way, and you have to clear it.

You operate a flying Ship and gather people’s feelings to launder them. Go up and down with X, so that you can gather the sentiments on your current Height. Beware of the dangers during your sky journey and observe new lands going by. Lift the moods while you fly high...and even higher!

Do you like word search games? In Word Warp, you must find more than 3000 words in 10 lan-guages (27000 Words).
Choose your favorite category out of 8 or mix them all together for the ultimate word find chal-lenge.
Three difficulties will help you adjust the game to your skills.

In Goo Patrol, you play as a fearless knight armed with a trusty pike. You can’t move, but you don’t need to. Slimes charge in from both sides across three platforms, and it’s up to you to switch lanes and strike at the right moment.
Attack left, attack right, and survive the waves of gooey invaders. With simple controls, fast-paced levels, and nonstop arcade action, Goo Patrol delivers satisfying, slime-splatting fun in every round.
Hold your ground. Clear the goo. Repeat.

From Two Sides is a fast paced arcade game played with only one button. You'll have to tap any button to change your direction and hold it to speed up, but you'll only have a short time before the wave of spikes come!

Many Turns One Road is a fast-paced endless runner where every move counts. Dash forward along a single twisting road filled with sharp turns, sudden obstacles, and challenging surprises. Test your reflexes as the path changes direction without warning, forcing you to react instantly or fall into the void. Collect points, chase high scores, and prove how far you can go on the road that never ends. Simple to play yet hard to master, this game will keep you hooked run after run.
Let's crush the space barriers at full speed! Interspace is a fast paced one-button arcade game where you'll have to aim and blast through space barriers to get the highest score possible!

In Road Turbo, the quiet suburban streets turn into your racetrack. You begin alone, a single runner facing a line of barrels, barricades, and enemies. With every step forward the pace quickens, and the challenge grows sharper. Collect boosts, find the right gates, and suddenly one becomes many. Your tiny crew doubles, triples, and surges down the road, transforming into a force powerful enough to crash through whatever stands in the way.
Slide, trip and jump! In TARUTOBI, a fast paced arcade game, you'll be doing all of this with just the push of a button

Think fast, fast thinker! COUNT is a fast paced mathematics arcade game where, as the title implies, you need to count fast!

The objective is quite simple, you have a counter that will quickly increase and you'll have random shapes with different colors to count.

The counter will go periodically faster and the counting objectives will get trickier and more confusing. Get as many right answers as you can in a row to get all the achievements. Don't get a wrong answer or wait too long because you will lose!
Hajwala Drift X, Play, simulate, Hajwala and drift. You can have fun and choose your favorite car and your favorite map. Choose your car and start drifting now

Turbo Hyper Drive is a fast-paced, action-packed racing game with a top-down perspective. As a car, you have to navigate through a series of levels that contain obstacles and ramps. The game's objective is to reach the finish line as quickly as possible

Design clever conveyor belt networks to sort colorful items into their correct destinations. What starts simple quickly becomes a brain-teasing challenge as you manage multiple colors, crossing paths, and tricky layouts.

CyberSmash is a high-speed endless runner set in a neon-soaked cyberpunk metropolis.

Players pilot a heavily modified street racer through rain-slicked city streets, crushing rogue AI robots while dodging environmental hazards.

The game combines the addictive nature of endless runners with the aesthetic appeal of retro-cyberpunk, creating an adrenaline-fueled experience of urban destruction.
Skullbreaker is an Arkanoid game where you have to help the skeleton return to the tower and regain its rightful place at the top

Run your very own animal hospital and treat adorable, sick, and dirty cats. Give medicine, wash muddy paws, and make sure every furry friend leaves with a smile. Upgrade your clinic with new beds, helpful staff, and other improvements as you earn coins from happy patients. The more you grow, the more cats you can help!

Hook, grab, and launch colorful orbs to pop multiples of the same color and keep the box from overflowing in this fast-paced puzzle challenge. Fill colored jars with bubbling energy to clear the screen!

1-2-Exquisite Word Search is the fourth game in the 1-2-Word Search series. Building upon the previous entries this classic word search puzzle game returns with a brand new set of levels, themes, and music! Exquisite Word Search packs in all new hand crafted puzzles built on 3 different grid sizes. 7x7, 10x10, and 12x12 word search grids return. Choose your puzzle solving mood by changing the background theme set and switching up the music on the TreeFall Radio. Embark on a fun and relaxing journey solving word searches in 1-2-Exquisite Word Search! Fun new puzzles await the discerning eye.

Sleep tight, and don't let the bed bugs bite! Fox's Zen House is a game where you must help a sleepy little fox to get through the night, while alarm clocks, telephones and jackhammers try to sabotage it! Upgrade your dream portal defenses, and eliminate the inconveniences!

Welcome to Puzzle Blast — the ultimate sliding-puzzle challenge that blends relaxing seaside vibes with addictive brain-teasing gameplay. Whether you are a casual player looking to unwind or a puzzle master chasing the perfect solution, Puzzle Blast offers hours of satisfying fun.
Alpine Skater takes mountain skating to the next level with tracks that span every kind of terrain the highlands can offer. From icy slopes and snow-dusted ridges to rugged rocky paths and many more.

Briks Boss Battle is a fast-paced arcade game where each level ends with a unique boss fight built into the stage. Use your deflector to bounce the ball, collect power-ups, and survive intense attacks in vibrant, high-energy arenas.

I Made Her Up is a narrative-driven visual novel that explores obsession, loneliness, and the power of creativity. It asks the timeless question: what if the person you loved most never truly existed?

Run, jump, and react fast! Cavrielle is an endless arcade-style runner where one brave girl dives into a dangerous cave full of coins, traps, and surprises. Easy to play, hard to master — perfect for quick sessions and high-score chases.

Rookie Knight is a fast-paced 2D action-platformer where you step into the boots of a young knight on his very first adventure. Run, jump, wall slide, and strike down enemies as you explore vibrant biomes filled with danger and discovery

Unleash retro mayhem in this fast-paced arcade slasher inspired by classic 80s games. Slice through endless waves of evil pumpkins, collect power-ups, and chase the highest score in pure pixelated chaos. Simple controls, 8-bit sound, and brutal fun await!

Take control of a flying saucer in this retro-style arcade game inspired by classic UFO legends. Circle around grazing cows with your beam, abduct them for fuel, and rack up massive combos! With low-poly 3D visuals and a nostalgic 90s vibe, this game is simple, addictive, and utterly out of this world.

The Jumping Orange 3 - from the makers of the Jumping Food Games

The Jumping Orange returns - even wilder, even juicier, even crazier. In The Jumping Orange 3, 15 new levels full of fast-paced action, surprising obstacles and comic-colored game worlds await you.

New level design, even more chaos:
Each stage brings fresh challenges that will test your timing and reflexes to the max.

Maximum fun in a tried and tested style:
Quick to get in, hard to let go - whether for in-between or on the hunt for points, every jump counts here.

Show what you're made of - and get the orange safely to the finish line.
The Jumping Orange 3 - play now and take the next jump.

Join Max, Jin, Lia and Zev in this fun adventure and skate around thanks to their customizable nano-skates, solve science puzzles adapted to different ages. Explore, learn and fight to save the future of humanity!

Join Willy in Willy’s Adventure, a fast-paced retro platformer packed with action and charm! Dash through a perilous castle, brave the icy snow fields, and face off against a fearsome boss in an epic final showdown. Armed with your trusty blaster and rocket-powered double jump, you’ll shoot, slide, and soar past monsters, spiders, and deadly traps in vibrant pixel worlds. With classic arcade energy and tight controls, Willy’s Adventure delivers the perfect blend of nostalgia and challenge — are you ready to conquer them all?
Fly through rainbow skies and chase the stars! Guide a cheerful pony across dazzling rainbow tracks, dodge clouds, and soar toward the highest score in this colorful endless runner!

You’re a fearless frog in an astronaut suit, stranded on a mysterious space station. Your mission? Hop between platforms, switch between yellow and blue, and collect matching gems while avoiding deadly lightning bullets.

Discover this prequel chapter of Kittengumi, which tells the story of what happened before the Sakabato was stolen, as well as different versions of the story that you can discover thanks to your decisions!

Ball Wall Jump Bump is a fast-paced arcade game where you control a bouncing ball between two walls. Dodge incoming obstacles, earn points for each successful escape, and flip to the other side with every hit. Jump, react, and keep the rhythm going — how long can you survive?

Slide The Tiles is a simple strategy puzzle game played on a 5x5 grid. Move the red block to new spaces, and with each move, a new block appears. Create full rows or columns to clear them, earn points, and keep the board from filling up. The goal is to plan ahead, manage space carefully, and reach the highest score possible.

If two balls collide, they create fireworks. However, there are rules... Engage in a sparkling fest of this fast-paced set of billiard themed minigames. Use as little hits as possible to score more! Hunt for bonuses to get more attempts! Set up your game's difficulty to your taste.

Step into the world of Delivery Dash Co., where every package counts and every second matters! With randomized delivery locations, hazards around every corner, and arcade-style bonuses, every run is a fresh adventure—whether you’re competing against rivals or shaping your own courier story.

Charge into the depths as a fearless knight on a fruity quest! In Knightritious, every run is an endless dash through perilous dungeons packed with bats, slimes, and devious traps. Collect as much fruit as you can while staying one step ahead of danger.
