Vyun, Kosmeya, and the Witch's Curse

A linear visual novel that tells us about the adventures of a budding writer, Kosmeya, who needs to take his manuscript to a competition in the capital, the path to which passes through a creepy forest.
Electricity changed our world forever, yet it remains fragile. We must handle it with care, or else we might just lose the wonders that it brings.

A small 2D platformer about a cat in an amazing hat. Go through all the obstacles, flying platforms, strange pistons, evil insects and mice. But all these obstacles should not prevent you from guiding the cat to the portal! But be careful, one wrong move and you will have to start all over again.
Step into the arena with Deadly Combat, a visceral one-on-one fighting game where each warrior brings deadly style. Dominate your rivals in fierce battles, master your character, and fight for glory.

Arm yourself with a massive gun and face endless waves of hostile wasps! Each enemy carries a colored marker — fire the matching bullet to bring them down. Quick reflexes and sharp aim are the only way to survive the swarm!

Switch between three platforms, time your shots, and don’t let the wasps close in. The hive won’t stop coming… but neither will you!

Are you interested in plague during the medieval times?
Then, this short-quiz game is for you.
Test your knowledge of history of medieval plague and then unlock a short movie called "Witness to Plague"
Pick a course, line up the shot, and roll for the cup. Golf: Minigolf is a clean, isometric putting game built for short sessions and satisfying hole-in-ones.

Soar through vibrant skies in The Colorful Biplane! Take control of your bright vintage aircraft and navigate through stunning low-poly landscapes filled with floating rings, hot air balloons, and exciting challenges. Collect points, avoid obstacles, and test your flying skills as you chase the highest score!

Become the unsung hero in Ambulance Simulator 911 Rescue, an engaging game where you play the role of both an ambulance driver and a paramedic. Receive emergency calls in real-time and react quickly: turn on the sirens, drive at high speed through heavy traffic, provide first aid at the scene, and safely transport patients to the hospital.

Hit The Clock is a simple arcade game where you shoot the hour hand of a moving clock to hit the next one. Each hit destroys the previous clock and increases the challenge with faster spins and smaller targets. Tap at the right moment to progress, and finish within the time limit to earn a star.
Twhols is a fast paced one-button arcade game where you are constantly moving at fast speeds and your objective is to survive and get rich in the process!
Step into the jigsaw puzzle world with a cozy twist.
Play, drift, Hajwala, and race in the city of Dubai.
Hallowkinz is a lighthearted Halloween-themed runner for all ages.
Uncover the secrets of an abandoned cursed village. Explore haunted locations, face twisted entities, and perform the final ritual to decide your fate.

In this fast paced one-button arcade game, you'll control a car's drift as you slalom through an endless road filled with barriers. Hold any button to make the car turn to a set direction and avoid the barriers. Each time you pass one, your direction will flip, so be mindful!
2d platform game with 2 different types of gameplay: run and gun and wall jumping with down pound attack

Mysterious artefacts of unknown origin have appeared throughout the universe. Due to recent events, central command is not leaving anything to chance. A disposal crew has been assembled to locate and destroy the cubes, wherever they might.

Under an old lamppost said to thin the veil between worlds, barista Diana seeks one impossible reunion—and meets her own double instead. The Lamplighter’s warning is clear: the lantern grants meetings and changes fate, but always takes a price. Choose your path in a branching, choice-driven story of grief, guilt, and sisterhood: bring Kira back and lose her memory of you, or keep your shared past intact and let the dead rest. Gentle slice-of-life days, midnight encounters, and striking CGs frame a haunting decision that asks what love is worth when memory fades. Two endings—both unforgettable.
Get ready for high-speed, precision racing on tracks that fit in your pocket! In Micro Race R, every millisecond counts as you master 11 unique, single-screen circuits.

Celestibun takes you on a whimsical run through an enchanted forest, where a brave little bunny girl dashes beneath glowing canopies to gather shimmering stars. Quick reflexes are key as buzzing wasps swoop and slow snails block the path, but every leap and hop carries you farther into the magical woods. Simple to play and endlessly replayable, it’s a charming adventure for anyone who loves fast, lighthearted fun.
In this game you must drop Christmas presents into a box to hold them on balance.

Stonebound is an infinite game type where Char jones gets trapped in an ancient temple after trying to steal the precious treasure of the place. With a click on the joystick button, help the character to change his direction to avoid the falling stones.

Odd One Out is a simple, fun word puzzle quiz game with 12 different subjects that can be selected on the rounds screen (for example Sport & Leisure). Each subject has 10 puzzles and each puzzle is a different category within the overall theme – for instance Ball Sports or Sports Equipment. For each category there are 12 answers on the screen but one does not belong in the category and is the odd one out. Simply find the answer in each category that does NOT belong. There is no time limit and each subject can be played as many times as you need to reach a great score!

Are you interested behind the scenes of indie game development? Then, this short-quiz game is for you. Test your knowledge of history of indie game development and then unlock a comedic short cartoon animation called "My Existential Crisis"

Orunex revives the spirit of early handheld shooters with a fresh arcade feel. Guide your starship through dangerous space sectors, dodging relentless enemy fire and striking back with precision. Simple to pick up yet challenging to master, Orunex delivers fast-paced action and nostalgic green-tinted pixel art for fans of retro space adventures.

Step into the hectic world of fast food management in Fast Food Master 2025! Whether you're flipping burgers solo or running a full kitchen with up to 6 friends, every second counts as you take customer orders, cook up meals, and keep the chaos under control. From sizzling burgers to crispy fries, master the art of fast food and build your dream restaurant!

Gear up for an all-out lunar shootout in Brothers in Duty – Space Brawl, an intense single-player team deathmatch set on the moon. Command your squad, outsmart enemy bots, and dominate the zero-gravity battlefield in this offline-only, AI-driven combat experience.

Cannon Defender is a fast-paced wave-based shooter where you control a powerful cannon to fight off endless enemies. Collect gems dropped by enemies and use them to create special boxes such as health, armor, rockets, and explosive boxes to survive longer and score higher. Face stronger waves, chain powerful attacks, and prove your skills in this challenging arcade experience.

In the afterlife you realize you are trapped in a cyber space as a digital spirit. Now you have to fight the digital Angel Virus to free your new dimension.

The game is a Boss Rush Bullet Hell shooter with upgrades. Fight 10 different bosses and try to defeat a secret boss for better ending!

Hexmin is a fast-paced one-button game.

There is a hexagon consisting of 6 small hexagons in the middle of the screen. Only two of the 6 sides can be active at the same time with one cell between them. You can change the active sides by rotating them clockwise by pressing a button. Your goal is to catch all the strings of hexagons coming towards the center with the active sides and don't let them touch any of the inactive ones.

The game is over when you miss a string.

Get ready for a fast-paced test of reflexes and precision!
In ShapeShift Rush, your goal is simple — match your shape with the obstacles ahead. Switch, slide, and adapt as the speed intensifies. Hit the obstacle that matches your form to survive, but collide with the wrong shape… and it’s game over!

Stay focused, react fast, and see how far you can go in this thrilling geometric challenge!

Sudoku is a simple and clear number-puzzle game.
The goal is easy to understand: fill the grid so each row, column, and 3×3 box contains the numbers 1 to 9 with no repeats. No math required, just logic.

Playing Sudoku helps improve focus, memory, and problem-solving skills in a calm and enjoyable way. It’s a quick mental exercise that keeps the brain active and sharp.

This version includes a wide variety of color themes, allowing you to play in the style that feels most comfortable for your eyes.

Easy to learn, relaxing to play, and beneficial for your cognitive health.

Master Detective is a lighthearted spot-the-difference game where you explore five charming cartoon locations such as a hospital, bank, and detective office, each hiding three subtle differences for you to uncover; with no timers, hints, or limits on attempts, the experience is simple, relaxed, and focused entirely on testing your observation skills as you work through every scene to prove you’ve got what it takes to become the Master Detective.

A puzzle game dedicated to the most wonderful time of the year. Assemble ten puzzles, each representing an iconic aspect of the holiday season. Challenge yourself to earn three stars on every stage to permanently unlock all puzzles as viewable rewards in the gallery.

Robots have attacked the flying city! But the shield protecting the city is not infinite.
Take control of the big cannon defending the city, get the highest score, and repel this deadly attack!

A vibrant retro platformer set in autumn-tinted fields where you sprint across earthy platforms while scooping up gleaming coins; five brisk handcrafted levels all wrapped in punchy pixel art and crisp controls. A game developed by CraePlay and ported by GGmuks.

Sanctum Push is a charming pixel art sokoban adventure where you play as a brave paladin pushing enemies into their rightful places to restore peace to a corrupted castle. Every move counts, plan carefully, position your foes, and clear each room to advance through the sanctum’s ever-changing halls.

Pixel Puzzles Christmas Jigsaws brings festive relaxation to your screen with 25 beautifully crafted Christmas-themed jigsaw puzzles. Choose your challenge level with puzzles ranging from 96 to 425 pieces. The game is perfect for both casual players and seasoned puzzlers alike. Whether you’re looking to unwind after a long day or get into the Christmas spirit, this traditional jigsaw experience offers calm, fun, and festive cheer.

What would that customer order? Will they be able to pay? Guess people's wishes, choose the correct option and build up your restaurant's Reputation to see new customers. Keep your Funds growing or face the loss.

Special customers come to the place with the high Reputation, so don't mess up these! Meet funny people along the way to a perfect Pizza Place!

Also, Triangle is for Pizza Slice.
Growth is a fast-paced one-button game.

Labubu Battle Royale plunges you into a vivid, living forest where every corner hides danger and excitement! Feel the adrenaline as you soar above the treetops, the wind rushing past, and prepare to land in a world where only the sharpest and quickest survive. The forest is alive with movement and sounds—rustling leaves, distant shouts, and the echo of distant gunfire. Every step could lead to glory or disaster, and every choice matters in your quest to become the ultimate survivor.
Tap, drag, and draw the perfect path. Floaty Rescue is a clean, line-drawing arcade game where you pilot a small rescue boat, collect coins, and scoop survivors before they drift away.

Match-Three - Farm Shoppers is not your average match-three game! You have a farm, and you've got customers. Make sure that they are getting their wares - otherwise your reputation will tank into oblivion! And remember - you can do EVERY move you want. If you need multiple swaps to make a match - go for it!

Celebrate the holiday season with 100 Christmas Hidden Cats, a cozy and charming hidden object adventure! Search through beautifully decorated rooms, snowy landscapes, and festive scenes to find adorable hidden cats. Each discovery brings joy and adds to your Christmas spirit. Relax, explore, and enjoy the heartwarming art and music as you uncover all the hidden kitties. Can you find all 100 cats and make this Christmas truly magical?

Space Adventure delivers an exciting endless-run experience set deep in the cosmos. Steer your spacecraft left and right to avoid asteroids, collect valuable coins, and chase new high scores. Simple controls, smooth gameplay, and endless challenges make every run a thrilling journey through space.

A minimalistic take on the classic arcade, this game provides 15 levels to destroy.

Catch bonuses, multiply your balls and don't lose them! When you're not busy with catching a ball, shoot the bricks. Aim into the corridors and enjoy that rebound.
It's golfing time! Take a deep breath as you swing your club and... what's that? Money in the air?

Drug Farmer Simulator plunges you into a gritty, atmospheric world where a small shop and hidden grow room can grow into a thriving underground business. Start with a few seedlings and slowly build your operation, experimenting with production, managing customers, and shaping your reputation. Every jar, every seedling, every bill is in your hands, making every choice matter.

A House That Glows is a choice-driven visual novel about a journalist who comes to help a forgotten village—and stumbles into a mystery that only appears at midnight. Stranded by a blizzard, Shon finds shelter with the kind Atcins family, hears whispers about an orphanage that burned long ago, and sees the impossible: a house shining on the hill where only ruins should be. Pulled between duty to his family and a promise to strangers, he follows the light and uncovers a story the world tried to bury.

As we go through life, it is inevitable that we will lose a thing or two. Items are misplaced all the time, but sometimes we can’t afford to lose them.

Whether they are an important part of our everyday routine, or they simply hold significant meaning to us, a moment will come when we have to remember where we might have lost something.
Join Boltie, the electric-blue little hero, in a classic pixel-art adventure inspired by 80s and 90s platformers! Jump, shoot and defeat enemies across fun and challenging stages!
Don't stop running! In Pseudo Collision you are escaping from the crazy scientist patented Mega-Death-Conveyor-Belt alongside a seemingly infinite number of minions.

Pixel Puzzles Fantasy Jigsaws brings mythical relaxation to your screen with 25 beautifully crafted fantasy-themed jigsaw puzzles. Choose your challenge level with puzzles ranging from 96 to 425 pieces. The game is perfect for both casual players and seasoned puzzlers alike. Whether you’re looking to unwind after a long day or escape into worlds of magic and legend, this traditional jigsaw experience offers calm, fun, and enchanting adventure.

Step into the dangerous and thrilling role of cartel in the ruthless world of Contrabandist: Contraband Cartel Simulator! In this high-stakes crime simulation, you begin as a small-time hustler and rise to become one of the most feared barons in the drug trade. Navigate the treacherous underworld, where wealth, power, and violence go hand in hand. Outwit rival cartels, bribe officials, and smuggle contraband across dangerous borders as you build a criminal empire that spans continents.

Dash through a magical forest in this fast-paced endless runner where every decision matters. Play as a nimble squirrel collecting acorns to boost your score, then transform into a fiery imp to defeat incoming enemies. Switch forms at the perfect moment, keep your momentum alive, and push your run as far as you can! Vultures, bats, and owls swoop in from above—some you dodge as a squirrel, others you burn away as a fire imp. Balancing both forms becomes the key to surviving longer and reaching higher scores.

Parallel Hearts is a romantic, choice-driven visual novel about a connection that starts where most stories end—after you close your eyes. Each night, Nora meets a boy by a quiet lakeside; each morning, she remembers everything…and he remembers nothing. As the dreams grow shorter, clues from the dream world begin pointing to places in the real one, and Nora must decide whether this is fate—or a feeling she’s brave enough to follow.

You Have One Shot is a game in which you will need to select the moment when exactly you need to shoot, since you only have one shell and you will need to use it to destroy all the enemies on the level. If you shoot and don't hit all the enemies, you will lose. If you destroy all enemies with one shell, you will move to the next level.
Jump Tobi, jump! Tobitaro is a fast paced one-button arcade game where you'll be jumping to avoid arrows and collect coins.

Odd One Out Christmas is a simple, fun word puzzle quiz game with 9 different festive subjects that can be selected on the rounds screen (for example Christmas Music). Each subject has 6 puzzles and each puzzle is a different category within the overall theme - for instance Christmas Carols or Christmas Pop Hits. For each category there are 12 answers on the screen but one does not belong in the category and is the odd one out. Simply find the answer in each category that does not belong. There is no time limit and each subject can be played as many times as you need to reach a great score!

Dive into high-speed arcade action inside a glowing, ever-shifting tunnel. Collect energy cubes, dodge incoming obstacles, and push your reflexes to the limit as the pace intensifies. Simple to learn but endlessly addictive, every run challenges you to survive longer, score higher, and master the perfect flow.
Imagine if you were to breakout, but you were... the ball! Imball is a one button arcade game that puts spin on the classic block breaker game by letting you control the ball!

Lust Anime Girls takes you into a fascinating world full of charm and mystery, where every anime heroine hides a deep story and unique power. You’ll have the chance to build close relationships with these seductive characters, train them, and equip them to face diverse challenges and dangerous enemies.
The game combines engaging strategy and action elements, giving you the freedom to explore magical lands and uncover secrets hidden around every corner. As you progress, you’ll unlock new abilities, discover hidden stories, and experience the tension between desire and power in a vibrant and dynamic anime universe.

Fill The Cup 3: Frost is a physics-based puzzle game where players guide water from a pipe into a cup. By holding a button, water flows and reacts to the environment, requiring players to overcome obstacles such as spikes, portals, moving platforms, and more. The game introduces freezing zones that allow players to freeze water and create solid paths to help redirect the flow into the cup. Each level includes a collectible snowflake that challenges players to complete the level perfectly. With simple controls, colorful cartoon visuals, and increasingly challenging puzzles, the game is suitable for children and casual puzzle players.
Survive the monochrome nightmare! Battle endless waves of enemies in this 1-bit tower defense shooter where every kill earns you currency to build your defense towers.

Along the far edge of the galaxy, station R-37 has picked up a strange signal. All contact was lost with the first team that was sent to investigate the scene. As a direct response, Central command has deployed the Dagger unit to follow up on this investigation and report back.

BitPew is a fast-paced retro arcade shooter inspired by classic handheld action. Take control of a robot head equipped with a vertical turret and put your memory and reflexes to the test. A faded silhouette of one of five enemy types slowly descends from the top of the screen. Watch carefully, identify the shape, and shoot the matching enemy before it reaches the bottom. Every mistake costs a life, and once they’re gone, it’s game over. With simple controls, chunky pixel graphics, and intense score-chasing gameplay, BitPew delivers a focused arcade experience where every shot matters.

Step into the fast-paced world of car sales and repairs in Car Dealer Garage Simulator 2026! Manage your own dealership and garage, buying, repairing, and selling vehicles to customers. Inspect used cars, fix mechanical problems, and customize rides to boost their value and attract buyers.

Handle customer requests, negotiate prices, and build your reputation in a competitive market. Upgrade your garage with advanced tools and hire skilled mechanics to speed up repairs. Expand your business by acquiring rare and luxury cars to offer the best selection.

With realistic vehicle physics and detailed environments, experience the thrill of running a successful car dealership and garage. Are you ready to become the top dealer in town?

Step into a cozy Christmas world full of festive charm and hidden details.
In this relaxing spot-the-differences experience, explore beautifully illustrated holiday scenes filled with snow, lights, decorations, and seasonal surprises.

Join Hori and his lovable crew of baby astronauts and their loyal Bernese Mountain Dog, Charlie, as they blast off on a thrilling journey across the galaxy! In The Adventures of Hori, you'll unravel cosmic mysteries, outsmart villainous cats known as the “Ronronneurs Maléfiques,” and discover magical objects like the Destructive Lollipop, all while forging bonds of friendship and teamwork. This heartwarming and humorous space tale is brought to life with adorable cartoon visuals, interactive choices, and immersive storytelling perfect for young players and families alike.

Falling Bricks Endless Smash is an addictive arcade challenge where endless waves of bricks keep falling, and your goal is to smash them, earn the highest score, and survive as long as possible. Collect powerful bonuses, unlock extra balls, and push your skills to the limit in the ultimate brick-smashing experience.

Bounce, sling, and shoot your way through endless challenges! In Slime Shot Adventure, you control a stretchy slime, launch it across obstacles, and test how far you can go. The further you sling, the tougher it gets – how long can you survive the endless adventure?

Pinball Strike Arcade Rampage is an endless pinball experience where every flip counts. Smash targets, collect shining diamonds, and rack up huge scores in pure arcade chaos. Dynamic backgrounds keep the action fresh while new bumpers appear to test your reflexes with every run. Easy to pick up, hard to master – how many diamonds and how high can you score?
Bomboban is a classic Sokoban-style puzzle game with an explosive twist: instead of pushing crates, you push enemy robots into bombs to defeat them and clear each stag
Zippyron is a relaxed yet engaging arcade flying game focused on movement, collection, and smooth progression.
Warp through the space in Gloop, a fast paced arcade game where you'll control your ship with just one button as the hyperspace glitches out!
Goals are a good thing. That distant objective that we always strive to chase. The X in the far distance that always somehow reappears.

Tractor Racers is a single-player racing and challenge-based game where players take control of powerful tractors and compete across 12 unique challenges, each designed to test driving skill, balance, speed, and strategy.

Block Cascade is a puzzle game in which players clear groups of matching blocks to trigger chain reactions and progress through levels. The game features 150 levels with varying layouts, obstacles, and objectives that require planning and strategic use of moves.
Players can use power-ups such as time manipulation, block removal, and block attraction to solve puzzles more efficiently. Gameplay focuses on creating cascades and managing board space to complete each stage and advance through the game’s progression.

Golf Journey Without End is an endless golfing adventure where every ball sunk into the hole earns you score and rewards you with extra swings to keep the journey going. Challenge yourself and see how high you can score!

Enter a meditative maze where every jump matters. Navigate through an abstract network of interconnected nodes as you search for the elusive blue Exit Node, with each leap subtly shifting your momentum and altering your journey's rhythm. Experience pure, distraction-free gameplay with minimalist vector graphics and a soothing color palette designed to focus your mind on the process itself. Random events will test your choices and dramatically change your path — will you accept the risk or play it safe in this zen-like puzzle adventure?

Twin Rockets is a game in which you control a rocket in space. You need to control her left and right rocket boosters. When you press left, you activate the left accelerator, thereby turning the rocket to the right, and vice versa. You receive points when collecting bonus objects along your way. You will lose if you fly off the playing field or if you crash into dangerous objects along the way.

Cute cat heroes fight endless waves of enemies with fully automatic weapons—focus on dodging and strategic upgrade choices while attacks fire automatically. Quick 5-minute roguelite arenas deliver charming, accessible bullet-hell action with unlockable heroes and persistent upgrades.
Fruits Drop is a bright, feel-good arcade puzzler where every color is a fruit, every match pops with satisfying juice, and every cleared line rockets your score higher

Odd One Out 2 is a simple, fun word puzzle game with 12 different subjects that can be selected on the rounds screen (for example Sport & Leisure). Each subject has 10 puzzles and each puzzle is a different category within the overall theme – for instance Water Sports or Famous Racehorses. For each category there are 12 answers on the screen but one does not belong in the category and is the odd one out. Simply find the answer in each category that does not belong. There is no time limit and each subject can be played as many times as you need to reach a great score!

Happy Ball Rush is a vibrant side-scrolling blaster game where precision, timing, and quick reflexes are your keys to victory. Take control of your rolling ball blaster, shoot through waves of numbered balloons, collect shining coins, and push your skills to the limit in an ever-moving world full of surprises.

The protagonist, whose name has been erased by the curse itself, is known only as the Drifter. His blood is infected with the "Ghost Plague"—an ancient malady that slowly transforms its bearer into an aggressive specter, losing its connection to the world of the living. With each passing day, he feels the world of the dead more intensely and belongs to himself less and less. His last hope becomes the legend of the "Ghost Blood Elixir"—an alchemical concoction said not to cure, but to subdue the curse, granting the bearer control over his demonic nature.

Welcome to RiddleWood, a mysterious puzzle adventure set in a world where nothing is quite as it seems. Step into an enigmatic woodland filled with handcrafted riddles, clever logic challenges, and interconnected puzzles that demand observation, patience, and creativity.

Pixel Puzzles Winter Jigsaws invites you to unwind with a cozy collection of beautifully crafted, winter-themed jigsaw puzzles. Designed for relaxation and focus, this traditional jigsaw experience lets you enjoy the calm of winter scenes at your own pace.
Cluckbit is a small arcade platformer with single-screen levels, designed to be easy to understand and fun to play.
Awaken alone in a shattered research station after a global viral catastrophe. The crew is gone. The systems are failing. And outside the station lies a dead world that should no longer hold life.

Tobacco Market Simulator puts you in charge of your very own tobacco shop, where every decision shapes your path to success. Start small, manage your stock, and learn the ins and outs of running a business in a competitive market. From pricing products to serving customers, your choices determine the growth of your shop—and your reputation in the community.
Just a small ride with the car and... wait, how did we end up here!?

Mote: Workshop is a short, atmospheric story game set in a forgotten woodworking shop, where every tool, plank, and dust mote carries the echo of a father who spoke more through his craft than his words. Explore the dimly lit space at your own pace, interact with worn tools and scattered plans, and piece together a quiet narrative about memory, family, and the comfort of focused work. With simple controls and a cinematic first-person view, Mote: Workshop invites you to slow down, listen to the creak of the floorboards, and find meaning in the small details left behind on the bench.
Timbershot is a fast-paced arcade shooter set along a rugged autumn trail filled with mischievous squirrels and ancient ents.

This website is totally safe and definitely won't clog your operational system with the infinite number of extremely annoying pop-ups.
It absolutely won't install some extra desktop decorations.
Click the button and enjoy the entirely not shady offer.

A silly webpunk vaporwave arcade begins!

Charge forward, take aim, and pop every target with soft foam darts. Foam Frenzy is a fast, first-person arcade runner where rubbery foes flood the lane and your toy blaster keeps them bouncing. Snap to weak points, chain knockbacks, and clear waves before they crowd you.

Pixel Puzzles Japan Jigsaws invites you to unwind with a serene collection of beautifully crafted jigsaw puzzles inspired by the landscapes, culture, and atmosphere of Japan. Designed for relaxation and focus, this traditional jigsaw experience lets you enjoy tranquil scenes at your own pace.
A memory game dedicated to the abstract beauty of colors.
Time to juggle like a real pro! Refbals is a super fast paced, one-button arcade game which will test your juggling skills to the max!
Help the snakes rest without disturbing each other by filling up the available space! Use your analytical skills to solve the puzzle and guide the snakes to their perfect resting spots.
Tankbit is a fast-paced endless arcade shooter where a cute green soldier rides a tiny tank into an ever-advancing battlefield.
Meet the Snoots behind the Snoot franchise. You can Boop the Snoot to get points.
Mega Carrier Simulator puts you behind the wheel of powerful heavy-duty transport vehicles built to haul oversized cargo across challenging routes.
Alien spaceships are invading our lands? Well... they have it coming! Have It Coming is a fast paced, one-button arcade game where you'll be defending the Earth and getting powered up while doing so!

Amer: The Chase Hit and Run

Ready to run the streets? In Amer Hit N Run, you’re dropped into an open world where you choose what happens next. Explore a map full of different neighborhoods that looks and plays better than ever on PlayStation with high-end graphics and smooth gameplay.

Alex the Rabbit is a classic, fun, and challenging 2D platformer. Join Alex, a brave rabbit, on an action-packed adventure through colorful and dangerous worlds. Your goal is to collect all the carrots scattered across the map, overcome obstacles and enemies, and find the Golden Carrot, located at the end of each level.

Retina Rush is a fast-paced arcade dodger where you play as a demon’s runaway eyeball, blazing across the sky in a desperate escape from hell and humanity alike. Glide through pixel-art mountain vistas while weaving between relentless missiles and cursed projectiles that fill the screen. Simple controls and tight, responsive movement make it easy to pick up, but ruthless enemy patterns and score targets test your focus, reflexes, and nerve. Chase higher scores, master risky near-misses, and prove you’ve got the vision to survive the rush.

MOTE: The Old Office is a reflective walking simulator where you explore an abandoned startup space through the eyes of its CEO. Wander through meeting rooms, break areas, and forgotten corners as voice memories surface—stories of late nights, impossible deadlines, and the small moments that shaped everything. Along the way, collect 20 hidden donuts—a sweet reminder of the “night shift” days when sugar and panic powered the dream.
Dive into a calm, cozy world with Lofi Mahjong. Enjoy classic Mahjong Solitaire enhanced by a lofi soundscape for maximum focus and minimum stress.

Case Files: Internal Affairs is the third installment in the Case Files series, a choice-driven detective adventure in which players investigate the deaths of two police officers and uncover the truth behind a mysterious case through evidence gathering, questioning suspects, and critical decision-making.

Choice of Life: Floors is a psychological horror detective game where every choice shapes your story. An elevator descends through the endless floors of your own home, leading you into a game against your own mind. Each step brings you closer to escape… or to madness

Stunt Paradise 2 - more speed, more explosions, more madness! Jump over ramps, dodge lasers, buzzsaws, and rockets while performing insane stunts. With new traps, improved graphics, and pure arcade chaos - get ready for the ultimate stunt challenge!
A fast-paced dark fantasy action roguelite where you chain attacks and parries into fluid, combo-driven combat through a twisted fairytale world.

Ahoy, matey! The clock is ticking for Captain Speedfin. Trapped with an hourglass that never stops, this pirate has only one choice: run. Your mission is simple but brutal: navigate 60 intense platforming levels to reclaim your chests before the last grain of sand falls. There are no special powers here—just pure skill. Every jump, slide, and dash is a test of your reflexes. In this world, the slightest mistake is fatal.
Do you like word search games? In Word Warp Animal Edition, you have to find animal names in 10 languages.

Furry Hearts is a cozy, school-set visual novel about finding your place—and the people who feel like home. You play as Kit, a fox who’s just moved to a new town, new house, and new class where he knows no one. Then come the firsts: a teammate who has your back (Lupus), a stage to help paint, a park that becomes “your spot,” and a girl whose smile you can’t stop sketching (Chloe). There’s a rival who runs too fast, an ex who scowls too hard, and a birthday that changes everything.
Final Payload is a fast-paced 2D action game where you control a guided warhead. Manage inertia and fuel, destroy enemies, avoid guarded zones, and land precisely to complete missions.
After the loss of his wife, architect Ethan withdraws from the world — until he becomes the first resident of an experimental smart home created to heal, protect, and optimize human life.

1-2-Dynamic Word Search is the fifth game in the 1-2-Word Search series. Building upon the previous entries this classic word search puzzle game returns with a brand new set of levels, themes, and one new big twist, multiplayer! In Dynamic Word search you can play local multiplayer with up to four friends and solve classic word search puzzles together! Although this is a cooperative experience, the game keeps track of which player finds the most words! This way you can compete with your friends and family as you work together to sovle each puzzle! Dynamic Word Search packs in all new hand crafted puzzles built on 3 different grid sizes, 7x7, 10x10, and 12x12. Choose your puzzle solving mood by changing the background theme set and switching up the music on the TreeFall Radio. Embark on a fun and relaxing journey solving word searches in 1-2-Dynamic Word Search! Fun new puzzles await the discerning eye.

Experience the nostalgic thrill of arcade shoot 'em ups with unique hand-drawn aesthetic. Battle endless waves of alien enemies while mastering the innovative tail-ramming mechanics and weapon overheat system. Collect powerful bonuses like shields and rapid-fire modes as you fight for survival.
Push your boundaries to stop the ritual

Sector Ninja is a stealth action game where you play as a ninja assassin moving through enemy controlled sectors with only a katana. To advance, you must clear every sector by eliminating all hostile ninjas across 2-3 stages. Enemies patrol with blades and weapons, and once they spot you, survival becomes much harder. Stay out of sight, approach carefully, and strike first with silent takedowns. Defeated enemies drop money that can be used to unlock new skins. As you progress, sectors become harder and require better timing and stealth.

G Press is a fast-paced one-button game.

You control a press that is constantly moving up and down. Your goal is to catch the rising bubbles and keep the liquid below from evaporating. Press a button to press the bubbles and turn them back into liquid.

The game is over when the liquid at the bottom runs out.

Think you know your colors? Color Inverter puts that to the test. A color appears on screen and your job is to instantly pick its perfect opposite from a set of choices. Sounds simple… until the streak counter climbs, and your brain starts second-guessing every shade.

Learn how complementary colors work in a fun, visual way: reds flip to cyan, greens pop into magenta, blues burst into yellow, and every weird in-between color has its own surprising opposite. With each correct answer you build a streak.

Survive as a soldier sent to suppress the zombie threat and find a vaccine to save humanity!

Join the H.A.D.E.S. special forces team as they drop into a cityscape overrun by zombies in hopes of recovering valuable research, evacuating a key scientist and perhaps even finding a vaccine to put an end to the apocalypse! Outbreak: Dead City is a cinematic narrative first-person shooter presented in low-poly 3D style.

Take the role of a soldier tasked with locating a hidden laboratory, use firearms and melee strikes to fend off undead hordes and work with your squad as you navigate the urban sprawl. Cycle between upgradeable weapon types like semi-automatic rifles, handguns and more, pick up ammo wherever you can find it and make contact with human survivors to gain information or supplies. Complete mission objectives and survive at all costs, then push your skills even further in New Game Plus.
Crazy Basket hurls you onto a wild street court where physics, timing, and a bit of chaos rule every shot.

Solar Machina is a vibrant 2D pixel art platformer where you control a robot on a colorful journey through tropical landscapes filled with traps and enemies. As you progress, your robotic suit evolves, granting new movement abilities that transform how you play. With smooth controls, distinct biomes, and a nostalgic chiptune soundtrack, Solar Machina offers a satisfying blend of challenge, rhythm, and exploration that keeps engagement from start to finish.
Step into the gritty world of Cut Corner Renovations USSR, where every crumbling wall and leaking pipe tests your creativity.
Get ready to cruise the neon sky with Piyopoyon, a fast paced one-button arcade game, while controlling... the ground!?
Come along on this adventure and help an explorer reach his destination. Run, jump, and dodge obstacles to reach your goal: Earth.

Step into the thrilling world of Mafia Business Simulator, a game where crime isn’t chaos — it’s a high-stakes, calculated business. Experience the excitement of running your own criminal empire in modern London, where every decision counts, every move shapes your influence, and every rival is waiting for a mistake. Stylish, immersive, and full of strategic depth, this is more than a game — it’s your chance to dominate the city from the shadows.
Fly and gather pollen to help flowers!

"Learn Basic Mandarin!!" is a game that helps to memorize 150 first level Mandarin Chinese words. The game also includes pinyin (their spelling) and a list of all the words. You have 5 lives which deplete after each wrong answer. Try to get the highest possible score.

In Tow is a fast-paced one-button game.

You score points by collecting chickens. The more chickens you have, the more points you get. To collect chickens, you run forward and jump between platforms. Hold a button to jump higher, press a button while mid-air to jump multiple times. The number of times you can jump depends on the number of chickens you have and you lose one chicken with each additional jump. You lose all your chickens when you hit a bullet.

The game is over when you fall or hit a bullet when you don't have any chicken.

Begin your journey in the Early Stone Age, when your ancestors lived in simple huts and survived through hunting and gathering. In Manor Dynasty Strategy, every resource you collect and every decision you make lays the foundation for generations to come.

The disposal team has discovered a strange transmission after the artefacts on site one were destroyed. Was this discovery meaningless, or could the artefacts hold a greater secret? Site two might just have the answer.

The level of challenge has grown. Fifteen stages will have to be cleared as part of site two. Intelligence suggests that the artefacts found there have regenerative capabilities. Due to these circumstances, central command has issued a software update to all units. Your power-ups will now recharge over time. Make good use of this.

Astro & Suzy Go to the Circus
Astro & Suzy are going to the circus! There are all kinds of yummy circus food being shot out of the circus cannons that Astro & Suzy are happy to eat.
Cosine? Tangent? Who needs that? Prepare your sine bombs and blast away!
Dash, leap, and slice through hand-crafted levels as a nimble ninja on a mission to grab every shuriken — and earn your sushi. Tight 2D precision platformer that make every jump count.

Medieval Quest is a Match-3 Puzzle game infused with RPG mechanics in a fantasy setting. Combine swords, arrows, staffs, and more to defeat enemies and achieve challenging quests.

Unlock the Archer, the Cleric and the Wizard characters to face and defeat the final Dragon.

Hank fights his battle against the monster breed. Kill as many monsters as you can to beat your high score. Get falling items for special weapons and assistance (Dynamite, Defense Tower, Rocket Tower, Repair Kit, Second Gun).

Lift Up is a fast-paced one-button game.

Your goal is to regulate the speed of the platform with the main character and to make sure that the main character avoids the walls on the sides. Hold a button to go up faster. The main character is constantly moving to one of the sides and can turn by collecting arrows indicating the direction on the way. All the arrows always point in one direction and they flip every time the main character picks up an arrow. The main character can also collect coins to score points.

The game is over when the main character hits a wall.

Red Bob is an inventor and biologist determined to study the region’s entire fauna. To achieve his ambitions, he created a special capture box capable of containing creatures without harming them. His mission is to regulate the population of each biome to prevent ecological imbalance, while also capturing creatures for research.

However, an accident during the transportation of the boxes caused them to scatter across the region. Now, Red Bob must track them down in order to restore control and properly capture the creatures once again.

Animal Genius turns animal trivia into a colorful classroom adventure where every question feels like a mini safari. Test your knowledge across three fun categories—identity, habitats, and wild fun facts—to discover just how much you really know about creatures big and small. With simple controls, bright visuals, and a friendly quiz-master vibe, it’s perfect for kids, families, and anyone who wants to see just how wild their animal brain really is.
It's time for paint wars! In this one-button controlled arcade, you'll be fighting with the evil blue team, and your weapon of choice? A paint ball!

Shadow Rose is a stylish puzzle adventure about two mysterious phantom thieves, Mysterious Mask X and Masked Beauty Z, infiltrating the Black Rose Auction House. Outsmart each room, manage your limited moves, uncover hidden treasures, and escape with elegance as the secrets behind the auction begin to unfold.

Play as Mysterious Mask X and Beauty Mask Z as they infiltrate an illegal auction to recover stolen and illegal treasures and relics. Plan every move carefully. One wrong step can make your escape impossible!

M Field is a fast-paced one-button game.

You are running through a minefield. Press a button to jump and press it twice to double jump. Hold a button to jump farther. Score points by destroying the enemies with the mine explosions, but be careful not to get caught in the explosion. You can jump on top of the enemies, but you can't touch them while you're on the ground.

The game is over when you get caught in an explosion or touch an enemy.

Step into the world of the S.E.X. Project, an experimental program in which multiple androids explore the boundaries of emotion, desire, and connection. Each synthetic companion has a unique personality, story, and path to uncover. Some seek love, some crave freedom, and some may hide dangerous secrets. Your choices will define their evolution and your fate.
Will you fall for them, help them, or lose yourself in simulated affection?

"You’re a tiny ninja on a giant sheet of paper. Dash across ink-thin platforms, dodge brutal traps, drop enemies with your bow, grab every coin you can, and dive through portals to find the exit. Rogue Doodle delivers tight, fast platforming with crisp pixel style, quick-to-learn controls, and “one more run” challenge."

Welcome to Parcel Inspection Simulator, where every package tells a story — and every detail matters. Step into the role of an inspector responsible for keeping the flow of parcels moving smoothly. From small envelopes to large shipments, dozens of packages pass through your hands each day. Check documents, inspect deliveries, and make sure everything reaches the right destination. Stay sharp, work efficiently, and turn a small inspection point into a thriving logistics operation.

Don’t Skip The Beat is a clean, arcade-style rhythm game where notes fall and you hit Up, Down, Left, and Right in time to the music across five energetic tracks. Learn the patterns, lock into the groove, and rack up points with precise timing—no fluff, just neon vibes, crisp feedback, and the pure satisfaction of nailing the beat. Quick to pick up and replayable by design, it’s all about chasing that better score and proving you won’t skip the beat.
Test your speed and reflexes in this special single-button arcade game!

Slide into a fast-paced winter adventure in Santa Slide Rush! Help Santa glide through slippery zig-zag snowy trails deep inside a magical pine forest while collecting presents for children around the world.

Master smooth steering, dodge tricky turns, and keep your momentum as the speed increases. new challenges, and even entirely different worlds to explore.

Untamed Isle is a laid-back treasure hunt with two bite-size levels built for pure relaxation. Wander through a lush jungle paradise, follow your curiosity, and scoop up glowing treasures hidden across the island—no tools, no combat, no stress. Just smooth exploration, bright vibes, and a cute cast to keep you company as you aim for a perfect clear.
I don't think a car should behave like this, but alas, it is happening! INOUTCAR is a fast paced one-button arcade game where your car somehow got stranded in space and it's spinning in circles.

Ace Heli Pilot drops you into the cockpit of a nimble chopper with one mission: beat the clock. Fly through tight city routes, land on tricky pads, rescue stranded targets, and hit every checkpoint before time runs out across 3 fast-paced levels.

Scaffold is a fast-paced one-button game.

Your goal is to build a path for the main character. Press a button to change the construction angle and hold a button to build. The main character will go faster when you build. Make the main character collect coins on the way to score points and avoid the moving spikes and obstacles.

The game is over when the main character falls or hits a spike or an obstacle.

Hidden Ninja Dojo is a charming hidden object-style game that challenges you to find ninjas hidden throughout each level. Carefully explore every scene, pay attention to small details, and uncover every ninja before moving on.

What looks simple at first can quickly become tricky, as ninjas blend into the background and hide in unexpected places. Whether you are a casual player or a fan of hidden object games, Hidden Ninja Dojo offers a relaxing and satisfying search experience.
The Curse 404 is a psychological horror puzzle game set inside a mysterious house trapped in a repeating time loop. Each time you awaken, the environment resets but the clues you discover remain.

Step onto the track in Mash Motion: Sprint Rush, a fast-paced arcade sprint where four runners line up and race for victory. Compete against three rivals in a straight dash to the finish, where every race is quick, intense, and decided in seconds.

With a nostalgic pixel art style and a classic stadium setting, the game captures the spirit of retro sports titles. The focus is simple: line up, race, and aim for first place. Each run is a short burst of competition that encourages immediate replay and constant improvement.

Whether you win or fall just behind, every race pushes you to try again and chase a cleaner, faster finish.
Bolmn has been sucked into a magic mirror. Help him escape his twisted reflections through a variety of challenges including 3D platforming, stealth, bomb throwing and pinball.

Step into a draft that refuses to stay still. MOTE: The Manuscript is the third entry in the MOTE series—a psychological walking simulator set within the crumbling mental landscape of a struggling writer. You play as a tiny wanderer navigating three eerie maze levels built from the pages themselves: Scribbles, Blank Pages, and Crumpled Paper. With minimal UI, unsettling sound design, and mind-bending post-process shifts, every corridor feels like a thought breaking apart mid-sentence. Discover short audio logs that hint at the writer’s unraveling story, and tackle a handful of small puzzles.
Dive into a vibrant and instantly accessible world of putting, perfect for players seeking a casual golf game with surprising depth.

"A lone samurai. Seven trials. One path to enlightenment.
The Crimson Wanderer walks a road few dare to find. At its end stands the enlightened one, undefeated, untouchable, the living myth of the blade.
Between you and him, seven legendary warriors wait in silence. Each one a wall. Each one a lesson.
This is not a battle of strength. It is a battle of stillness. One breath. One moment. One truth.
Honor the fallen. Carry their wisdom. Let each duel shape the swordsman you are becoming.
The path is long. The silence is deep. The enlightened one is waiting."

BLOCK RUN is a fast, minimalist grid-based dodge game where you play as a single square racing to the far side of the arena across 10 quick levels. Each stage is a short, high-pressure run on a live grid. Enemy blocks move left and right in predictable “ping-pong” paths, with some resetting automatically, pushing you to judge timing, bait openings, and slip through at the exact moment; no extra assets, no distractions—just pure top-down arcade precision and rapid retries.

The Space War IV rages on! You thought this was going to be just another normal skirmish, but seems like fate has another plan for you, and now your ship navigation controls have gone completely crazy!

A mysterious portal has appeared right in the middle of the dungeon,
and of course there is a way to escape from it, but our Knight is not a coward
and will accept this deadly battle against the vile creatures rushing at him from
this portal!

Backrooms: The Twisted One is a tense horror escape experience set in the classic yellow liminal halls of the Backrooms. Explore 3 levels across Normal and Hard difficulties while haunted doll entities stalk your every move. They freeze when watched, but the moment you look away, they close in. Search the maze for collectible VHS tapes, stay alert, and find your way out before the twisted ones reach you.

Not Turn is a fast-paced one-button game.

Your goal is to go down the platforms while avoiding the enemies. You slide down the pillars that hold the platforms and you can choose to switch the pillar using the nearest platform by pressing a button. Hold a button to speed up. Collect the coins that the enemies drop to score points.

The game is over when you hit an enemy.
What happened on the oil platform? Find out in this third-person action game, search for clues and eliminate the zombies
Step into Blackwood House, a haunting text-driven horror mystery where every command pulls you deeper into a cursed family's buried past.
A Word-Finding Journey from the Deep Sea to Deep Space!

You play as a speedy raccoon on his quest for snacks. Collect fruits that make you strong and break those sweet trash cans open! Unlock fancy skins and powerful upgrades while enjoying hand-crafted art and music.
Dating Stories 2 blends the addictive satisfaction of solving jigsaw puzzles with the spicy thrill of seducing the most alluring women you can imagine.

Hamventure is a platformer featuring creative puzzles and engaging challenges. Guide a small pig through 40 levels, overcoming traps such as spikes, saws, and arrows that react to your movements.
Each level introduces new situations that will make you think before taking your first jump.

Step into the fast lane in Traffic Rush: Ultimate Drive, a high-speed arcade driving experience where precision, reflexes, and timing are everything.

Navigate through intense traffic, dodge incoming vehicles, and master the road as you push your driving skills to the limit. The longer you survive, the higher your score but one mistake can end it all.

Compete against players worldwide with a dynamic leaderboard system, unlock achievements, and prove that you are the ultimate driver.

Features:
- Fast-paced arcade driving gameplay
- Global leaderboards compete with the best
- Challenging achievements to unlock

Enter fast-paced tank arenas where sharp movement and quick decisions are the keys to survival. Fight relentless enemies, switch between four distinct weapons and take on a new challenge in every level - hunt for hidden keys, capture zones, complete time trials and more!

Battle through 20 increasingly difficult levels across the Arcade, Void, Paper and Distort arenas, then test your skills in four objective-free Endless modes. Stay mobile, master every weapon and survive the chaos in Tank Odyssey.

Shardwatch Dominion is a classic top-down tower defense game set in circular arenas. You protect a central fortress and its glowing crystals from waves of enemies that attack from every direction.
Every decision matters: where you build, what you spend crystals on, and which upgrades you take between waves. Placement and resource management decide whether the fortress holds.

games.originalName: Wand & Order: Tidy Up the Magic Shop!

Wand & Order: Tidy Up the Magic Shop!

Cozy first person co-op organizing and cleaning simulator! Sort wands, tarot decks and potions. Tidy up the shop to earn points and unlock powerful spells that help you restore order before the Alchemist returns!
A simple arcade-action game focused on catching eggs and collecting escaped chicks while avoiding a dog.

Taxi passengers across a cyberpunk cityscape with speed and precision!

Soar through neon-lit skies delivering passengers to their destinations as you pilot a taxi ship with speed and precision! Skygrid Courier is a physics-based action puzzler that requires you to manage the momentum of your craft to avoid obstacles and safely reach targets around single-screen cityscapes. Pick up passengers one at a time and fly to the landing pad of their color-coded destinations including clinics, clubs, hotels and labs.

Plan your route with quick-thinking strategy so you don’t run out of power for your ship and watch your shields! If you collide with objects or fly through hazards, a rough landing could cut your trip short! Choose from the task-based Mission mode to earn rewards, Arcade mode to race against the clock or Versus mode to compete in local multiplayer. Check your Hangar for unlockables as you progress, including alternate ships. Can you master the busy skyways of a neon-lit future, or will you crash and burn?

games.originalName: QUTAS67: Qubic Ultimate Tap Adventure Simulator 2067

QUTAS67: Qubic Ultimate Tap Adventure Simulator 2067

Every criminal starts somewhere. You start in a dumpster. Welcome to Miami, 2067, where the economy is a joke and you’ve decided to become the punchline. Click to earn cash, upgrade your Click Power and work your way through 20 locations, from parking lots to banks and museums. Your goal? Stealing The Legendary Game the whole world has been waiting for. Apparently, asking nicely wasn't an option.
Build your own car empire in Garage Mechanics 2026

Frankenstein: Awakening of Horror is an upcoming third-person survival horror game set in a frozen gothic landscape. Players navigate cursed streets, morgues, and Dr. Frankenstein’s laboratory while surviving both brutal creatures and the horrors of his experiments.

80's Disco Brawl is a rhythm-based beat ’em up that throws you into the spotlight of the wildest dance floor in history, where every fight is a rhythm, every hit a beat, and every move a performance. Step into a world where combat and music collide, and your timing becomes your greatest weapon.

games.originalName: I Want to Play the Villain!

fields.value: I Want to Play the Villain!
I Want to Play the Villain!

I Want to Play the Villain! is a theatre-themed logic puzzle game. To create the perfect show, you must match actors to their roles. But every actor has their own ambitions, fears, and wishes. Rearrange the cast, change the story, and use your logic to make everyone happy!

Step into the shoes of a clerk in 3AM ANOMALY STORE: Night Shift Horror, a tense first-person horror simulation where running a quiet roadside convenience store is only the beginning. This isn't your average neighborhood market. While you keep the shelves stocked, answer calls, and serve customers, a dark supernatural secret lurks just out of sight.
Behind the backroom door, a shimmering portal awaits. Every night, you must feed an otherworldly creature with specific visitors - not true human beings, but entities that look like ordinary people. You must solve the mystery of who belongs and who is an anomaly before they leave your sight.

Midnight strikes.
The gates slam shut.
The manor begins to breathe… and hunt.

You are Vanessa Mort — the lost soul trapped inside the haunted Institute on Wednesday the 13th, the cursed night when walls whisper, shadows stalk, and your darkest fears take shape. Every creak in the dark could be a jump scare. Every corridor could be your last.

Step into the paws of the world’s stealthiest operative, a highly trained skunk agent on a mission to infiltrate, sabotage, and extract without ever being seen. Adorable on the outside, unstoppable in the field.

In this dynamic stealth-action adventure, you’ll crawl through shadows, leap across rooftops, and sabotage alien technology using a unique arsenal of spy tools. Set traps, deploy gas bombs, or vanish entirely with invisibility mode; every mission can be approached your way.

Hero Siege is a Hack 'n' Slash game with roguelike- & RPG elements. Annihilate hordes of enemies, grow your talent tree, grind better loot and explore up to 7 Acts enhanced with beautiful Pixel Art graphics! This game offers countless hours of gameplay and up to 4 player online multiplayer!

Lorna Ritten, has learned of Alfred Cypress, her grandfather whom she has never known. She has always wanted to find out more about her family but it has been somewhat of a mystery. But she also learns of what she has inherited, of which she has no idea of just how important this actually is to her and others. Wanting to know more, this leads her into the beginning of a very unique situation. Regardless of what she is facing, she must continue forward to achieve what is needed for herself, and so much more!.

Arriving at a secluded island, the setting is somewhat overwhelming. But, even with the vastness and mystery of the Island, she wants to find the answers to questions she has had for so long. While knowing very little about Alfred Cypress, it is very obvious he has an eccentric nature, as well as brilliance in him. The technology discovered conveys all this in many ways. There is so much to do, not a lot of time, and the realization of the need to be extremely careful.

Cypress Inheritance: The Beginning will give you a unique gaming experience to enjoy. We intended for this game to enable the player to have options, as well as objectives in an environment with an AI that is defending the area. Cypress Inheritance: The Beginning delivers a true-to-life, stealthy gaming experience set in multiple open worlds. As you experience our true cause and effect system while on the path to achieving your goals, the strategy you use will have consequences and those decisions will ultimately determine your success or failure.

Cypress Inheritance: The Beginning includes Chapters I and II, with Chapter III. Chapters II and III continue the story, giving more to encounter and discover. These three chapters together conclude this first game.
The recent events in a state prison, involving Jake from Hot Guns Team was a perfect moment for some prisoners to escape - you are one of them.

The world of coach drivers awaits you! Drive along motorways and country roads to the bus stations in over 40 cities in Germany. Thanks to the cooperation with FlixBus and true-to-the-original MAN buses, you will experience the game world in a realistic way.

Become a one man machine to operate the biggest equipment in the world. Use it to dig, drive, transport, demolish and more. Make your way in to space by fulfilling objectives in 12 exciting missions in immersive story mode.

Frontier pilots simulator is a environment centered single player vehicle sim combining skill-based flying system with a story-driven economic progression system. Your piloting expertise will be constantly challenged by the world while it unfolds before you. Each contract has multiple routes and players will be the ones to decide what kind of experience they get.
Basingstoke has been invaded by the Titans, and everyone else is dead.

Elderborn is a Metal Action Fantasy Slasher with brutal FPP melee combat and souls-like/RPG character progression. In the times of legend, the barbarian tribes need a new dark messiah. The player becomes a merciless slayer who will uncover ancient secrets in the city of doom, and forge their own destiny. This ambitious indie game, five years in the making, combines old-school single-player feel, a classic heroic story, and modern level of skill-based challenge. All this and more creates an action-packed, lore-filled, engaging adventure that will last 8-10 hours in a single play-through.
Fight on multiple fronts in Holdfast: Nations At War - A multiplayer first and third-person shooter set during the great Napoleonic Era and WW1. Charge into battle with over 150 players per server!

In Junkyard Simulator you play as owner of scrap yard, which with his own hands is trying to create the largest junkyard in the area.
The way you do it depends on your decision! Do you want to manually search and collect the best scrap?

Take over the duties of a border guard inspector in a communist country of the 80's. Smuggling, corruption and forgery are the order of the day here. Be vigilant and earn the respect of your superiors.

Aimlabs is a training platform designed by gamers to help sharpen up your core FPS aiming skills. Aimlabs offers a comprehensive set of tools to improve your aim, regardless of which FPS you play. It provides curated aim training scenarios that will turn you into an aim God in no time.

Dive into specifically designed aim training exercises to master the art of flicking, tracking, speed, perception, and cognition. What sets Aimlabs apart is its ability to provide detailed aim analysis feedback, giving you valuable insights and guiding you towards rapid improvement.

Aimlabs is continuously updated with new features to ensure compatibility with a wide range of games. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned pro, Aimlabs is an invaluable tool for gaining a competitive edge.

Ad Infinitum is an atmospheric single-player horror game, which puts you into a World War I setting seen through a first-person perspective. You find yourself in the trenches of a forlorn battlefield where your are being hunted by vicious creatures. Solve puzzles to clear pathways and sneak through trenches to hide from vicious creatures. Avoid dangerous threats and try to escape this world of pain and death. Besides the realistic graphics, the game features a stealth system, puzzle-solving and exploration of the vicious game world which all culminates in a subtle yet intense story.
Gunhead is a fast paced open world FPS where you take the role of a pirate mech with a gun for a head, looting derelict spaceships filled with monstrous drones made out of bone and steel.

Set sail into the vibrant open world of Skull and Bones, a naval online action RPG where you rise to become the most fearsome pirate kingpin.

Customize your fleet, craft unique ships, and forge formidable weapons to dominate in exhilarating sea battles against your foes, all while expanding your pirate empire. Join a dynamic and ever-evolving world that brings fresh challenges, features, and stories with each season, immersing you in a continuously unfolding pirate saga.

Dive into this nautic adventure as curiosity will guide you through a space ship wreck on an unknown planet made up of water. When one of the lead scientists still on board tries to unriddle the possibility of a relaunch young Janitor Harold is around to assist her. Join Harold in his clumsy undertakings to stir up the ark-like ship’s stale day-to-day life and find the secrets that lie behind its doors.

Underwater atmosphere, self-reflective humor and contemporary adventure mechanics make up the foundation of this game created entirely out of craft supplies.

UBOAT is a simulator of a submarine from WWII era. It is a survival sandbox with crew management mechanics while its primary theme is life of German sailors. The boat is their home, but it can become their grave at any time.
A puzzle game developed by Mighty Rabbit Studios.

Embark on an epic odyssey to save your sister and the whole of humankind from dimensional invaders in a stylish single player action-adventure RPG.

Chain lightning-fast combos, learn new abilities, and upgrade your weapons as you take on formidable enemies and colossal bosses in fast, dynamic combat.

From the creator of The Binding of Isaac, Super Meat Boy and The End is Nigh comes... Mewgenics! A game where you hoard, breed, train and set cats out on epic adventures through a sprawling world of complete chaos.
Level up your team as you venture further and further from your home, collect unique items, defeat epic bosses, gain mutations, and return home so you can breed and further your bloodline in this turn based legacy roguelike draft sim about cats!
Explore a city of Gothic architecture torn between past and future in Desolus, a first person puzzle game.
Infinitesimals is a story-driven, 3rd person action adventure where you play as tiny aliens who stand only 1mm tall. Though a diminutive species, they are technologically advanced and space faring.
A simple sci-Fi arcade game about the adventures of an astronaut in space. Jump and collect stars, and try not to get caught in the tentacles of an ancient monster.

This is a casual, 3D game with space battles. The purpose of the game is to defeat opponents of 20 levels. The player controls five different spaceships (1 fighter and 4 battleships) at each level. During the battle you can switch ships and different ships can attack different opponents.

Create your own bus empire on Fuerteventura now! Thanks to the economy system in the new Tourist Bus Simulator, you will be able to found your own bus company on the popular holiday island Fuerteventura.
This game is four kinds of party games arranged Bingo.

Ever dreamed of becoming a super hero that protects the city with your super powers?
Undefeated makes that dream come true! Fly over the city to patrol the streets and
look out for crimes or troubles. Use your unlimited powers to keep the city safe.

Iron Danger is a tactical combat game with a unique time manipulation mechanic. A never before seen combination that combines the tactical depth of turn-based games with the exciting action of real-time games.

Tackle challenging encounters with your party of two characters, using a variety of skills and highly interactive environments.

Maybe you will set an enemy on fire and kick them into a grain field for a proper barbeque, or set up a trap and fell a tree on top of them. The options are endless and it is you who will be deciding your own approach!
Explore the birth of sapient AI in this atmospheric hacking adventure set in the sprawling world of Recompile.

Become a real paleontologist, explore various environments and search for dinosaur fossils. Dig for and study the remnants of these majestic creatures to learn about their evolution. Build your own museum and experience an immersive background story.

Play as another US president! Decide the fate of the world and run the country any way you like. Do you wish to start a war or make peace? Take care of the poorest or support capitalists? Advocate for gun rights or stand against them? It is all up to you!

Blue Protocol is set in a world spun by “overwhelming graphics along the lines of anime movies” and incorporates multiplayer action that utilizes the qualities of an online game. It runs on Unreal Engine 4.

Open the doors between your everyday reality and a dark unholy world to unveil the mystery of the disappearance of your child. Explore both worlds to find clues, solve puzzles, decide whether you infiltrate or fight brutal enemies and stand up to an aberrant establishment.
Imagine that you don't have any modern technology. Use your mind to build from scratch your first primitive tools and constructions.

Brave the challenging conditions of Alaskan life in the definitive trucker simulator. Be the master of your own destiny as you take jobs, transport cargo and experience a sense of freedom on foot and in your cab.

We all live with the fear of reaching the shadow of dementia. The ultimate fear of forgetting. The fear of not remembering our past, what led us here. For who do we become when we forget who we are?

Back Then is a first-person narrative game journey taking place in the mind of Thomas Eilian, an elderly writer diagnosed with Alzheimer's Disease. The gameplay, presented in first-person perspective, is story-driven and is heavily focused on interactions, puzzles and detective exploration.

Take on the role of a one-man renovation team tasked with restoring various sports facilities to their former glory. Many of them have been destroyed as a result of time or lack of care. Don't let them go into complete oblivion - roll up your sleeves and breathe new life into them!

Reveil is a narrative first-person psycho-thriller game that focuses on story, puzzles and exploration. Find out what’s going on inside Walter Thompson and what his dark past at the Nelson Bros Circus has to do with it.

Get behind the wheels of classic Russian locomotives and check if the wild animals, bad people, severe frosts and constantly changing weather are able to stop you. Try to survive in the longest railway line in the world!

Once you get tangled with the mob, you will forever be a part of the mob. At least they pay a decent salary and all you have to do is clean up after their dirty work, but you know what you’re doing. So clean crime scenes, outsmart the police and get ready for the next mission.

Shadows of Doubt is a detective stealth game set in a fully-simulated neo-noir metropolis.

An open world stealth game with a whole city of secrets at your fingertips!

Set in an alternate reality hyper-industrialized 1980s where the government outsources police work to private corporations and contractors. You play the role of a private intelligence investigator, making money by finding and selling information. Capture of the rampant serial killer carries a hefty bounty, but who knows what secrets you’ll find along the way. In this world of secrets & lies, information is power, and the cards you hold are determined by how far you’ll go to acquire it…

Break into apartments, rifle through secret documents and hack security systems. The entire world is fully simulated. Each citizen has an apartment, a job, a daily routine, favorite things to do, places to go, and people to interact with. Uncover this knowledge and use it to your advantage!
Imagine that you have divine powers. What do you do? Help people or take the piss out of them? That's a priest's life.

Deadside is a hardcore multiplayer shooter with large open world and wide gameplay possibilities. Deadside gets you into realistic game environment full of hopelessness and despair. It tries to keep balance between the dynamics of the shooter and the hardcoreness of “survival” gameplay. The world of the game does not imply the existence of fantastic elements like zombies or anomalies, concentrating the player's attention on realistic aspects of life on the ruins of the dead civilization.

The End of the Sun is a first-person exploration and adventure story-based game, embedded in the Slavic world. This is a series of mysterious events that ordinary people dealt with, as they were living in a small village where the line between myth and reality became to fade perilously.

In the distant future when civilization is on the verge of extinction, people follow the legend of the Elysium in the last city, Havenswell. In this post-apocalyptic wasteland sci-fi ARPG, you will play as Arrisa, a Blader with immortality, and explore the city ruin to find the hope of a new life.

A virtual ticket redemption arcade with realistic physics, silly prizes and a bunch of goofy robots. The Coin Game is made by a solo developer. Be sure to add us to your wishlist for new announcements.

Build a local car wash into a massive detailing empire! Master advanced cleaning techniques with vibrant active foams, beat the clock for extra tips, and buy or lease new properties. Play it clean or risk everything with high-paying shady deals and secret backroom plantations.
Put out the fires and rescue the hostages in this fast-paced arcade game!

games.originalName: Runner Heroes: The Curse of Night and Day

Runner Heroes: The Curse of Night and Day

RUNNER HEROES is a unique adventure in which you control two characters at the same time. Play in single mode or with a friend in two cooperative modes. Addiction and challenge at full speed through 47 levels. Do you accept the challenge?

Team up or face it alone in this top down zombie slaying defense adventure! Featuring up to 4 player online co-op, cleanse the infected wave by wave and upgrade your base with traps & defenses to build the Ultimate Zombie Defense. Can YOU stop them?
The sequel to Shaolin vs Wutang! Shaolin vs Wutang 2 is a INDIE love letter to Martial Arts and classic Kung Fu films. Made for casual game fans not intended for Hardcore Fighting Game players.
